verses.sa:
ऋधङ्मन्त्रो योनिं य आबभूवामृतासुर्वर्धमानः सुजन्मा ।
अदब्धासुर्भ्राजमानोऽहेव त्रितो धर्ता दाधार त्रीणि ॥
verses.rom:
ridhanmantro yonim ya ababhuvamritasurvardhamanah sujanma |
adabdhasurbhrajamano'heva trito dharta dadhara trini ||
verses.en: He who came to (ā-bhū) the womb (yóni) with a special sacred text (? ṛ́dhan̄mantra), of immortal spirit (-ásu), increasing, of good birth, of unharmed spirit, shining like the days—Trita the maintainer maintained three (trí, neuter).

verses.sa:
आ यो धर्माणि प्रथमः ससाद ततो वपूंषि कृणुषे पुरूणि ।
धास्युर्योनिं प्रथम आ विवेशा यो वाचमनुदितां चिकेत ॥
verses.rom:
a yo dharmani prathamah sasada tato vapumshi krinushe puruni |
dhasyuryonim prathama a vivesha yo vachamanuditam chiketa ||
verses.en: He who first attained to (ā-sad) the ordinances (dhárman) makes thence many wondrous forms; eager (? dhāsyú) he first entered the womb (yóni), he who understood (ā-cit) speech unspoken.

verses.sa:
यस्ते शोकाय तन्वं रिरेच क्षरद्धिरण्यं शुचयोऽनु स्वाः ।
अत्रा दधेते अमृतानि नामास्मे वस्त्राणि विश एरयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaste shokaya tanvam rirecha ksharaddhiranyam shuchayo'nu svah |
atra dadhete amritani namasme vastrani visha erayantam ||
verses.en: He who left (ric) [his] body to thy heat (çóka), flows the gold; his [men] are bright (çúci) after; there they (two) assume (dhā) immortal names; let the clans (víç) send garments for us.

verses.sa:
प्र यदेते प्रतरं पूर्व्यं गुः सदःसद आतिष्ठन्तो अजुर्यम् ।
कविः शुषस्य मातरा रिहाणे जाम्यै धुर्यं पतिमेरयेथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadete prataram purvyam guh sadahsada atishthanto ajuryam |
kavih shushasya matara rihane jamyai dhuryam patimerayetham ||
verses.en: When these formerly went further forth, approaching each unfading seat—the poet of the dry (? çuṣá), the two licking mothers—do ye (two) send for the sister (jāmí) a capable (dhúrya) spouse.

verses.sa:
तदू षु ते महत्पृथुज्मन् नमः कविः काव्येना कृणोमि ।
यत्सम्यञ्चावभियन्तावभि क्षामत्रा मही रोधचक्रे वावृधेते ॥
verses.rom:
tadu shu te mahatprithujman namah kavih kavyena krinomi |
yatsamyanchavabhiyantavabhi kshamatra mahi rodhachakre vavridhete ||
verses.en: This great homage, verily, to thee, O broad-going one, do I a poet make with poesy (kā́vya); when the two (m.), going united (samyáñc) against the earth (kṣā́), [then] increase here the (two) great bank-wheeled (? ródhacakra) ones (f.).

verses.sa:
सप्त मर्यादाः कवयस्ततक्षुस्तासामिदेकामभ्यंहुरो गात्।
आयोर्ह स्कम्भ उपमस्य नीडे पथां विसर्गे धरुणेषु तस्थौ ॥
verses.rom:
sapta maryadah kavayastatakshustasamidekamabhyamhuro gat|
ayorha skambha upamasya nide patham visarge dharuneshu tasthau ||
verses.en: Seven bourns (maryā́dā) did the poets fashion; unto one of these verily went one distressed; in the nest of the nearest (upamá) community (? āyú) stood the pillar (skambhá), at the release (visargá) of the roads, in the supports (dharúṇa).

verses.sa:
उतामृतासुर्व्रत एमि कृन्वन्न् असुरात्मा तन्वस्तत्सुमद्गुः ।
उत वा शक्रो रत्नं दधात्यूर्जया वा यत्सचते हविर्दाः ॥
verses.rom:
utamritasurvrata emi krinvann asuratma tanvastatsumadguh |
uta va shakro ratnam dadhatyurjaya va yatsachate havirdah ||
verses.en: Also, of immortal spirit, vowed (? vráta), I go performing; spirit, soul, of the body then (? tát) with kine (? sumádgu); and either the mighty one (çakrá) assigns treasure, or as the oblation-giver pursues (? sac) with refreshment.

verses.sa:
उत पुत्रः पितरं क्षत्रमीडे ज्येष्ठं मर्यादमह्वयन्त्स्वस्तये ।
दर्शन् नु ता वरुण यास्ते विष्ठा आवर्व्रततः कृणवो वपूंषि ॥
verses.rom:
uta putrah pitaram kshatramide jyeshtham maryadamahvayantsvastaye |
darshan nu ta varuna yaste vishtha avarvratatah krinavo vapumshi ||
verses.en: Also son prays (? īḍ) father for dominion; they called for well-being him of the chief bourn (?); may they see now, O Varuṇa, those that are thy shapes (viṣṭhā́); mayest thou make wondrous forms of the one much rolling hither.

verses.sa:
अर्धमर्धेन पयसा पृणक्ष्यर्धेन शुष्म वर्धसे अमुर ।
अविं वृधाम शग्मियं सखायं वरुणं पुत्रमदित्या इषिरम् ।
कविशस्तान्यस्मै वपूंष्यवोचाम रोदसी सत्यवाचा ॥
verses.rom:
ardhamardhena payasa prinakshyardhena shushma vardhase amura |
avim vridhama shagmiyam sakhayam varunam putramaditya ishiram |
kavishastanyasmai vapumshyavochama rodasi satyavacha ||
verses.en: Half with half milk thou mixest (? pṛç); with half, O Asura (?), thou increasest [thy] vehemence (?). We have increased the helpful (çagmíya) companion, Varuṇa, lively (iṣirá) son of Aditi; poet-praised wondrous forms have we spoken for him—the (two) firmaments (ródasī) of true speech.

verses.sa:
तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो यज्ञ उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः ।
सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रून् अनु यदेनं मदन्ति विश्व ऊमाः ॥
verses.rom:
tadidasa bhuvaneshu jyeshtham yato yajna ugrastveshanrimnah |
sadyo jajnano ni rinati shatrun anu yadenam madanti vishva umah ||
verses.en: That verily was the chief among beings whence was born the formidable one, of bright manliness; as soon as born, he dissolves [his] foes, when all [his] aids (ū́ma) revel after him.

verses.sa:
ववृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर्दासाय भियसं दधाति ।
अव्यनच्च व्यनच्च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु ॥
verses.rom:
vavridhanah shavasa bhuryojah shatrurdasaya bhiyasam dadhati |
avyanachcha vyanachcha sasni sam te navanta prabhrita madeshu ||
verses.en: Increasing with might (çávas), he of much force, a foe, assigns (dhā) fear to the barbarian, winning (n.) both what breathes not out and what breathes out; brought forward (n.), they resound together for thee in the revelings.

verses.sa:
त्वे क्रतुमपि पृञ्चन्ति भूरि द्विर्यदेते त्रिर्भवन्त्यूमाः ।
स्वदोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा समदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः ॥
verses.rom:
tve kratumapi princhanti bhuri dviryadete trirbhavantyumah |
svadoh svadiyah svaduna srija samadah su madhu madhunabhi yodhih ||
verses.en: In thee they mingle skill abundantly, when they twice, thrice become [thine] aids; unite thou with sweet (svādú) what is sweeter than sweet; mayest thou fight against yonder honey with honey (mádhu).

verses.sa:
यदि चिन् नु त्वा धना जयन्तं रणेरणे अनुमदन्ति विप्राः ।
ओजीयः शुष्मिन्त्स्थिरमा तनुष्व मा त्वा दभन् दुरेवासः कशोकाः ॥
verses.rom:
yadi chin nu tva dhana jayantam ranerane anumadanti viprah |
ojiyah shushmintsthirama tanushva ma tva dabhan durevasah kashokah ||
verses.en: If now after thee that conquerest riches in contest after contest (ráṇa) the devout ones (vípra) revel, more forcible, O vehement one, extend thou what is stanch; let not the ill-conditioned Kaçokas damage thee.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं शाशद्महे रणेषु प्रपश्यन्तो युधेन्यानि भूरि ।
चोदयामि त आयुधा वचोभिः सं ते शिशामि ब्रह्मणा वयांसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya vayam shashadmahe raneshu prapashyanto yudhenyani bhuri |
chodayami ta ayudha vachobhih sam te shishami brahmana vayamsi ||
verses.en: By thee do we prevail in the contests, looking forward to many

verses.sa:
नि तद्दधिषेऽवरे परे च यस्मिन्न् आविथावसा दुरोणे ।
आ स्थापयत मातरं जिगत्नुमत इन्वत कर्वराणि भूरि ॥
verses.rom:
ni taddadhishe'vare pare cha yasminn avithavasa durone |
a sthapayata mataram jigatnumata invata karvarani bhuri ||
verses.en: Thou didst set that down in the lower and the higher, in what abode (duroṇá) thou didst aid with aid; cause ye to stand there the moving mother; from it send ye many exploits.

verses.sa:
स्तुष्व वर्ष्मन् पुरुवर्त्मानं समृभ्वाणमिनतममाप्तमाप्त्यानाम् ।
आ दर्शति शवसा भूर्योजाः प्र सक्षति प्रतिमानं पृथिव्याः ॥
verses.rom:
stushva varshman puruvartmanam samribhvanaminatamamaptamaptyanam |
a darshati shavasa bhuryojah pra sakshati pratimanam prithivyah ||
verses.en: Praise thou fully, O summit, the many-tracked, skilful (? ṛ́bhvan), most active (iná) Āptya of the Āptyas; may he look on with might, he of much force; may he overpower the counterpart of the earth.

verses.sa:
इमा ब्रह्म बृहद्दिवः कृणवदिन्द्राय शूषमग्रियः स्वर्षाः ।
महो गोत्रस्य क्षयति स्वराजा तुरश्चिद्विश्वमर्णवत्तपस्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
ima brahma brihaddivah krinavadindraya shushamagriyah svarshah |
maho gotrasya kshayati svaraja turashchidvishvamarnavattapasvan ||
verses.en: These incantations (bráhman) may Brihaddiva, foremost heaven-winner, make, a strain (çūṣá) for Indra; he rules, an autocrat, over the great stall (gotrá); may he, quick (? túra), rich in fervor, send (?) all.

verses.sa:
एवा महान् बृहद्दिवो अथर्वावोचत्स्वां तन्वमिन्द्रमेव ।
स्वसारौ मातरिभ्वरी अरिप्रे हिन्वन्ति चैने शवसा वर्धयन्ति च ॥
verses.rom:
eva mahan brihaddivo atharvavochatsvam tanvamindrameva |
svasarau mataribhvari aripre hinvanti chaine shavasa vardhayanti cha ||
verses.en: So hath the great Brihaddiva Atharvan spoken of his own self (tanū́) [as of] Indra; the two blameless, mother-growing sisters—[men] both impel them with might (çávas) and increase them.

verses.sa:
ममाग्ने वर्चो विहवेष्वस्तु वयं त्वेन्धानास्तन्वं पुषेम ।
मह्यं नमन्तां प्रदिशश्चतस्रस्त्वयाध्यक्षेण पृतना जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
mamagne varcho vihaveshvastu vayam tvendhanastanvam pushema |
mahyam namantam pradishashchatasrastvayadhyakshena pritana jayema ||
verses.en: Be splendor mine, O Agni, in rival invocations (vihavá); may we, kindling thee, adorn ourselves; let the four directions bow to me; with thee as overseer may we conquer the fighters.

verses.sa:
अग्ने मन्युं प्रतिनुदन् परेषां त्वं नो गोपाः परि पाहि विश्वतः ।
अपाञ्चो यन्तु निवता दुरस्यवोऽमैषां चित्तं प्रबुधां वि नेशत् ॥
verses.rom:
agne manyum pratinudan paresham tvam no gopah pari pahi vishvatah |
apancho yantu nivata durasyavo'maisham chittam prabudham vi neshat ||
verses.en: O Agni, pushing back the fury of our adversaries, do thou, our keeper (gopā́), protect us about on all sides; let our abusers (durasyú) go away downwards; among themselves (amā́) let the intent of them awaking be lost.

verses.sa:
मम देवा विहवे सन्तु सर्व इन्द्रवन्तो मरुतो विष्णुरग्निः ।
ममान्तरिक्षमुरुलोकमस्तु मह्यं वातः पवतां कामायास्मै ॥
verses.rom:
mama deva vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto vishnuragnih |
mamantarikshamurulokamastu mahyam vatah pavatam kamayasmai ||
verses.en: Let all the gods be at my separate call—the Maruts with Indra, Vishṇu, Agni; let the broad-spaced atmosphere be mine; let the wind blow (pū) for me unto this desire.

verses.sa:
मह्यं यजन्तां मम यानीष्टाकूतिः सत्या मनसो मे अस्तु ।
एनो मा नि गां कतमच्चनाहं विश्वे देवा अभि रक्षन्तु मेह ॥
verses.rom:
mahyam yajantam mama yanishtakutih satya manaso me astu |
eno ma ni gam katamachchanaham vishve deva abhi rakshantu meha ||
verses.en: Let what sacrifices I make make sacrifice for me; let my mind's design be realized (satyā́); let me not fall into (ni-gā) any sin soever; let all the gods defend me here.

verses.sa:
मयि देवा द्रविणमा यजन्तां मयि आशीरस्तु मयि देवहूतिः ।
दैवाः होतारः सनिषन् न एतदरिष्टाः स्याम तन्वा सुवीराः ॥
verses.rom:
mayi deva dravinama yajantam mayi ashirastu mayi devahutih |
daivah hotarah sanishan na etadarishtah syama tanva suvirah ||
verses.en: On me let the gods bestow (ā-yaj) property; with me be blessing (āçís), with me divine invocation; may the divine invokers (hótar) win that for us; may we be unharmed with our self (tanū́), rich in heroes.

verses.sa:
दैवीः षडुर्वीरुरु नः कृणोत विश्वे देवास इह मादयध्वम् ।
मा नो विददभिभा मो अशस्तिर्मा नो विदद्वृजिना द्वेष्या या ॥
verses.rom:
daivih shadurviruru nah krinota vishve devasa iha madayadhvam |
ma no vidadabhibha mo ashastirma no vidadvrijina dveshya ya ||
verses.en: Ye six divine wide ones, make wide [space] for us; all ye gods, revel here; let not a portent find us, nor an imprecation; let not the wrong that is hateful find us.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो देवीर्महि नः शर्म यच्छत प्रजायै नस्तन्वे यच्च पुष्टम् ।
मा हास्महि प्रजया मा तनूभिर्मा रधाम द्विषते सोम राजन् ॥
verses.rom:
tisro devirmahi nah sharma yachchhata prajayai nastanve yachcha pushtam |
ma hasmahi prajaya ma tanubhirma radhama dvishate soma rajan ||
verses.en: Ye three goddesses, grant (yam) us great protection, what is prosperous (puṣṭá) for our progeny and for ourselves (tanū́); let us not be deserted (hā) by progeny nor selves; let us not be made subject to the hater, O king Soma.

verses.sa:
उरुव्यचा नो महिषः शर्म यच्छत्वस्मिन् हवे पुरुहूतः पुरुक्षु ।
स नः प्रजायै हर्यश्व मृडेन्द्र मा नो रीरिषो मा परा दाः ॥
verses.rom:
uruvyacha no mahishah sharma yachchhatvasmin have puruhutah purukshu |
sa nah prajayai haryashva mridendra ma no ririsho ma para dah ||
verses.en: Let the bull (mahiṣá) of wide expanse grant us protection, having much food (-kṣú), [he] the much-invoked in this invocation; do thou be gracious unto our progeny, O thou of the bay horses; O Indra, harm us not, do not abandon us.

verses.sa:
धाता विधाता भुवनस्य यस्पतिर्देवः सविताभिमातिषाहः ।
आदित्या रुद्रा अश्विनोभा देवाः पान्तु यजमानं निर्ऋथात् ॥
verses.rom:
dhata vidhata bhuvanasya yaspatirdevah savitabhimatishahah |
aditya rudra ashvinobha devah pantu yajamanam nirrithat ||
verses.en: The Creator (dhātár), the disposer (vidhātár), he who is lord of being, god Savitar, overpowerer of hostile plotters, the Ādityas, the Rudras, both the Açvins—let the gods protect the sacrificer from perdition (nirṛthá).

verses.sa:
ये नः सपत्ना अप ते भवन्त्विन्द्राग्निभ्यामव बाधामह एनान् ।
आदित्या रुद्रा उपरिस्पृशो नो उग्रं चेत्तारमधिराजमक्रत ॥
verses.rom:
ye nah sapatna apa te bhavantvindragnibhyamava badhamaha enan |
aditya rudra uparisprisho no ugram chettaramadhirajamakrata ||
verses.en: They that are our rivals—away be they; with Indra and Agni do we beat (bādh) them down; the Ādityas, the Rudras, sky-reaching (? uparispṛ́ç), have made our over-king a stern corrector.

verses.sa:
अर्वाञ्चमिन्द्रममुतो हवामहे यो गोजिद्धनजिदश्वजिद्यः ।
इमं नो यज्ञं विहवे शृणोत्वस्माकमभूर्हर्यश्व मेदी ॥
verses.rom:
arvanchamindramamuto havamahe yo gojiddhanajidashvajidyah |
imam no yajnam vihave shrinotvasmakamabhurharyashva medi ||
verses.en: Hitherward do we call Indra from yonder, who is kine-conquering, riches-conquering, who is horse-conquering; let him hear this sacrifice of ours at our separate call; of us, O thou of the bay horses, hast thou been the ally (medín).

verses.sa:
यो गिरिष्वजायथा वीरुधां बलवत्तमः ।
कुष्ठेहि तक्मनाशन तक्मानं नाशयन्न् इतः ॥
verses.rom:
yo girishvajayatha virudham balavattamah |
kushthehi takmanashana takmanam nashayann itah ||
verses.en: Thou that wast born on the mountains, strongest of plants, come, O kúṣṭha, effacer (-nā́çana) of takmán, effacing the fever (takmán) from here.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णसुवने गिरौ जातं हिमवतस्परि ।
धनैरभि श्रुत्वा यन्ति विदुर्हि तक्मनाशनम् ॥
verses.rom:
suparnasuvane girau jatam himavataspari |
dhanairabhi shrutva yanti vidurhi takmanashanam ||
verses.en: On an eagle-bearing (-súvana) mountain, born from the snowy one (himávant); they go to [it] with riches, having heard [of it], for they know the effacer of fever.

verses.sa:
अश्वत्थो देवसदनस्तृतीयस्यामितो दिवि ।
तत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं देवाः कुष्ठमवन्वत ॥
verses.rom:
ashvattho devasadanastritiyasyamito divi |
tatramritasya chakshanam devah kushthamavanvata ||
verses.en: The açvatthá, seat of the gods, in the third heaven from here; there the gods won the kúṣṭha, the sight (cákṣaṇa) of immortality (amṛ́ta).

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययी नौरचरद्धिरण्यबन्धना दिवि ।
तत्रामृतस्य पुष्पं देवाः कुष्ठमवन्वत ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyayi nauracharaddhiranyabandhana divi |
tatramritasya pushpam devah kushthamavanvata ||
verses.en: A golden ship, of golden tackle (-bándhana), moved about in the sky; there the gods won the kúṣṭha, the flower of immortality.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययाः पन्थान आसन्न् अरित्राणि हिरण्यया ।
नावो हिरण्ययीरासन् याभिः कुष्ठं निरावहन् ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyayah panthana asann aritrani hiranyaya |
navo hiranyayirasan yabhih kushtham niravahan ||
verses.en: Golden were the roads, the oars golden, the ships were golden by which they brought out the kúṣṭha.

verses.sa:
इमं मे कुष्ठ पूरुषं तमा वह तं निष्कुरु ।
तमु मे अगदं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
imam me kushtha purusham tama vaha tam nishkuru |
tamu me agadam kridhi ||
verses.en: This man of mine, O kúṣṭha—him bring, him relieve (nis-kṛ), him also make free from disease for me.

verses.sa:
देवेभ्यो अधि जातोऽसि सोमस्यासि सखा हितः ।
स प्राणाय व्यानाय चक्षुषे मे अस्मै मृड ॥
verses.rom:
devebhyo adhi jato'si somasyasi sakha hitah |
sa pranaya vyanaya chakshushe me asmai mrida ||
verses.en: From the gods art thou born; of Soma art thou set as companion; do thou be gracious to my breath, out-breathing, sight here.

verses.sa:
उदङ्जातो हिमवतः स प्राच्यां नीयसे जनम् ।
तत्र कुष्ठस्य नामान्युत्तमानि वि भेजिरे ॥
verses.rom:
udanjato himavatah sa prachyam niyase janam |
tatra kushthasya namanyuttamani vi bhejire ||
verses.en: Born in the north from the snowy [mountain], thou art conducted to people (jána) in the eastern [quarter]; there have they shared out the highest names of the kúṣṭha.

verses.sa:
उत्तमो नाम कुष्ठस्युत्तमो नाम ते पिता ।
यक्ष्मं च सर्वं नाशय तक्मानं चारसं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
uttamo nama kushthasyuttamo nama te pita |
yakshmam cha sarvam nashaya takmanam charasam kridhi ||
verses.en: Highest by name, O kúṣṭha, art thou; highest by name thy father; both do thou efface all yákṣma, and do thou make the fever sapless.

verses.sa:
शीर्षामयमुपहत्यामक्ष्योस्तन्वो रपः ।
कुष्ठस्तत्सर्वं निष्करद्दैवं समह वृष्ण्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
shirshamayamupahatyamakshyostanvo rapah |
kushthastatsarvam nishkaraddaivam samaha vrishnyam ||
verses.en: Head-disease, attack (? upahatyā́), evil of the eyes, of the body—all that may kúṣṭha relieve, verily a divine virility (vṛ́ṣṇya).

verses.sa:
रात्री माता नभः पितार्यमा ते पितामहः ।
सिलाची नाम वा असि सा देवानामसि स्वसा ॥
verses.rom:
ratri mata nabhah pitaryama te pitamahah |
silachi nama va asi sa devanamasi svasa ||
verses.en: Night [is thy] mother, cloud (nábhas) [thy] father, Aryaman thy grandfather; silācī́, verily, by name art thou; thou art sister of the gods.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा पिबति जीवति त्रायसे पुरुषं त्वम् ।
भर्त्री हि शश्वतामसि जनानां च न्यञ्चनी ॥
verses.rom:
yastva pibati jivati trayase purusham tvam |
bhartri hi shashvatamasi jananam cha nyanchani ||
verses.en: He who drinketh thee liveth; thou rescuest a man (púruṣa); for thou art a sustainer (bhartrī́) of all, and a hiding-place (? nyáñcanī) of people.

verses.sa:
वृक्षंवृक्षमा रोहसि वृषण्यन्तीव कन्यला ।
जयन्ती प्रत्यातिष्ठन्ती स्परणी नाम वा असि ॥
verses.rom:
vrikshamvrikshama rohasi vrishanyantiva kanyala |
jayanti pratyatishthanti sparani nama va asi ||
verses.en: Tree after tree thou climbest, like a lustful girl; conquering, standing by (? pratyā-sthā), winner (spáraṇī) verily by name art thou.

verses.sa:
यद्दण्डेन यदिष्वा यद्वारुर्हरसा कृतम् ।
तस्य त्वमसि निष्कृतिः सेमं निष्कृधि पूरुषम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaddandena yadishva yadvarurharasa kritam |
tasya tvamasi nishkritih semam nishkridhi purusham ||
verses.en: If (yát) by a staff, if by an arrow, or if by flame (? háras) a sore is made, of that thou art relief; relieve thou this man.

verses.sa:
भद्रात्प्लक्षान् निस्तिष्ठस्यश्वत्थात्खदिराद्धवात्।
भद्रान् न्यग्रोधात्पर्णात्सा न एह्यरुन्धति ॥
verses.rom:
bhadratplakshan nistishthasyashvatthatkhadiraddhavat|
bhadran nyagrodhatparnatsa na ehyarundhati ||
verses.en: Out of the excellent plakṣá thou arisest, out of the açvatthá, the khadirá, the dhavá, the excellent banyan (nyagródha), the parṇá; do thou come to us, O arundhatī́.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णे सुभगे सूर्यवर्णे वपुष्टमे ।
रुतं गच्छासि निष्कृते निष्कृतिर्नाम वा असि ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyavarne subhage suryavarne vapushtame |
rutam gachchhasi nishkrite nishkritirnama va asi ||
verses.en: Thou gold-colored, fortunate, sun-colored one, of most wondrous forms; mayest thou go to the hurt (? rutá), O relief; relief, verily, by name art thou.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णे सुभगे शुष्मे लोमशवक्षणे ।
अपामसि स्वसा लाक्षे वातो हात्मा बभूव ते ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyavarne subhage shushme lomashavakshane |
apamasi svasa lakshe vato hatma babhuva te ||
verses.en: Thou gold-colored, fortunate, vehement (? çúṣmā), hairy-bellied one—sister of the waters art thou, O lākṣā; the wind was thy soul.

verses.sa:
सिलाची नाम कानीनोऽजबभ्रु पिता तव ।
अश्वो यमस्य यः श्यावस्तस्य हास्नास्युक्षिता ॥
verses.rom:
silachi nama kanino'jababhru pita tava |
ashvo yamasya yah shyavastasya hasnasyukshita ||
verses.en: Silācī́ by name—thy father, O goat-brown one, is a maid's son; Yama's horse that is dark brown (çyāvá)—with its mouth (? blood ?) art thou sprinkled.

verses.sa:
अश्वस्यास्नः संपतिता सा वृक्षामभि सिष्यदे ।
सरा पतत्रिणी भूत्वा सा न एह्यरुन्धति ॥
verses.rom:
ashvasyasnah sampatita sa vrikshamabhi sishyade |
sara patatrini bhutva sa na ehyarundhati ||
verses.en: Fallen from the horse's mouth, she invaded the trees; having become a winged brook (? sarā́), do thou come to us, O arundhatī́.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद्वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेन आवः ।
स बुध्न्या उपमा अस्य विष्ठाः सतश्च योनिमसतश्च वि वः ॥
verses.rom:
brahma jajnanam prathamam purastadvi simatah surucho vena avah |
sa budhnya upama asya vishthah satashcha yonimasatashcha vi vah ||
verses.en: The bráhman that was first born of old, Vena hath unclosed from the well-shining edge; he unclosed the fundamental nearest positions of it, the womb of the existent and of the non-existent.

verses.sa:
अनाप्ता ये वः प्रथमा यानि कर्माणि चक्रिरे ।
वीरान् नो अत्र मा दभन् तद्व एतत्पुरो दधे ॥
verses.rom:
anapta ye vah prathama yani karmani chakrire |
viran no atra ma dabhan tadva etatpuro dadhe ||
verses.en: Who of you did what first unattained deeds—let them not harm our heroes here; for that purpose I put you forward.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधार एव ते समस्वरन् दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतः ।
तस्य स्पशो न नि मिषन्ति भूर्णयः पदेपदे पाशिनः सन्ति सेतवे ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradhara eva te samasvaran divo nake madhujihva asashchatah |
tasya spasho na ni mishanti bhurnayah padepade pashinah santi setave ||
verses.en: In the thousand-streamed one they resounded (svar) together, in the firmament (nā́ka) of the sky, they the honey-tongued, unhindered. His zealous (bhū́rṇi) spies wink not; in every place are they with fetters for tying.

verses.sa:
पर्यू षु प्र धन्वा वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः ।
द्विषस्तदध्यर्णवेनेयसे सनिस्रसो नामासि त्रयोदशो मास इन्द्रस्य गृहः ॥
verses.rom:
paryu shu pra dhanva vajasataye pari vritrani sakshanih |
dvishastadadhyarnaveneyase sanisraso namasi trayodasho masa indrasya grihah ||
verses.en: Round about do thou run forward in order to the winning of booty, round about overpowering adversaries (vṛtrá, n.); then thou goest over haters by the sea (arṇavá). Weakling (sanisrasá) by name art thou, the thirteenth month, Indra's house.

verses.sa:
न्वेतेनारात्सीरसौ स्वाहा ।
तिग्मायुधौ तिग्महेती सुशेवौ सोमारुद्राविह सु मृडतं नः ॥
verses.rom:
nvetenaratsirasau svaha |
tigmayudhau tigmaheti sushevau somarudraviha su mridatam nah ||
verses.en: Now (not?) hast thou succeeded (rādh) by that, thou yonder (asāú): hail! having sharp weapons, having sharp missiles, very propitious, O Soma and Rudra, do ye be very gracious to us here.

verses.sa:
अवैतेनारात्सीरसौ स्वाहा ।
तिग्मायुधौ तिग्महेती सुशेवौ सोमारुद्राविह सु मृडतं नः ॥
verses.rom:
avaitenaratsirasau svaha |
tigmayudhau tigmaheti sushevau somarudraviha su mridatam nah ||
verses.en: Thou hast failed (ava-rādh) by that, thou yonder: hail! having sharp etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपैतेनारात्सीरसौ स्वाहा ।
तिग्मायुधौ तिग्महेती सुशेवौ सोमारुद्राविह सु मृडतं नः ॥
verses.rom:
apaitenaratsirasau svaha |
tigmayudhau tigmaheti sushevau somarudraviha su mridatam nah ||
verses.en: Thou hast offended (apa-rādh) by that, thou yonder: hail! having sharp etc. etc.

verses.sa: मुमुक्तमस्मान् दुरितादवद्याज्जुषेथां यज्ञममृतमस्मासु धत्तम् ॥
verses.rom: mumuktamasman duritadavadyajjushetham yajnamamritamasmasu dhattam ||
verses.en: Do ye (two) release us from difficulty, from reproach (avadyá); enjoy ye the offering; put in us immortality (amṛ́ta).

verses.sa:
चक्षुषो हेते मनसो हेते ब्रह्मणो हेते तपसश्च हेते ।
मेन्या मेनिरस्यमेनयस्ते सन्तु येऽस्मामभ्यघायन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
chakshusho hete manaso hete brahmano hete tapasashcha hete |
menya menirasyamenayaste santu ye'smamabhyaghayanti ||
verses.en: O missile (hetí) of sight, missile of mind, missile of incantation (bráhman), and missile of penance! weapon's weapon (mení) art thou; weaponless be they who show malice against us.

verses.sa:
योऽस्मांश्चक्षुषा मनसा चित्त्याकूत्या च यो अघायुरभिदासात्।
त्वं तान् अग्ने मेन्यामेनीन् कृणु स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yo'smamshchakshusha manasa chittyakutya cha yo aghayurabhidasat|
tvam tan agne menyamenin krinu svaha ||
verses.en: Whoever with sight, with mind, with intention, and whoever with design, malicious, shall attack us—do thou, O Agni, with weapon make them weaponless: hail!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य गृहोऽसि ।
तं त्वा प्र पद्ये तं त्वा प्र विशामि सर्वगुः सर्वपूरुषः सर्वात्मा सर्वतनूः सह यन् मेऽस्ति तेन ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya griho'si |
tam tva pra padye tam tva pra vishami sarvaguh sarvapurushah sarvatma sarvatanuh saha yan me'sti tena ||
verses.en: Indra's house art thou; to thee there I go forth; thee there I enter, with all my kine, with all my men, with all my soul, with all my body, with that which is mine.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य शर्मासि ।
तं त्वा प्र पद्ये तं त्वा प्र विशामि सर्वगुः सर्वपूरुषः सर्वात्मा सर्वतनूः सह यन् मेऽस्ति तेन ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya sharmasi |
tam tva pra padye tam tva pra vishami sarvaguh sarvapurushah sarvatma sarvatanuh saha yan me'sti tena ||
verses.en: Indra's refuge art thou; to thee etc. etc.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वर्मासि ।
तं त्वा प्र पद्ये तं त्वा प्र विशामि सर्वगुः सर्वपूरुषः सर्वात्मा सर्वतनूः सह यन् मेऽस्ति तेन ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya varmasi |
tam tva pra padye tam tva pra vishami sarvaguh sarvapurushah sarvatma sarvatanuh saha yan me'sti tena ||
verses.en: Indra's defense art thou; to thee etc. etc.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वरूथमसि ।
तं त्वा प्र पद्ये तं त्वा प्र विशामि सर्वगुः सर्वपूरुषः सर्वात्मा सर्वतनूः सह यन् मेऽस्ति तेन ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya varuthamasi |
tam tva pra padye tam tva pra vishami sarvaguh sarvapurushah sarvatma sarvatanuh saha yan me'sti tena ||
verses.en: Indra's guard (várūtha) art thou; to thee etc. etc.

verses.sa:
आ नो भर मा परि ष्ठा अराते मा नो रक्षीर्दक्षिणां नीयमानाम् ।
नमो वीर्त्साया असमृद्धये नमो अस्त्वरातये ॥
verses.rom:
a no bhara ma pari shtha arate ma no rakshirdakshinam niyamanam |
namo virtsaya asamriddhaye namo astvarataye ||
verses.en: Bring to us, stand not about, O niggard; do not prevent (? rakṣ) our sacrificial gift as led [away]; homage be to baffling (vīrtsā́), to ill-success; homage be to the niggard.

verses.sa:
यमराते पुरोधत्से पुरुषं परिरापिणम् ।
नमस्ते तस्मै कृण्मो मा वनिं व्यथयीर्मम ॥
verses.rom:
yamarate purodhatse purusham parirapinam |
namaste tasmai krinmo ma vanim vyathayirmama ||
verses.en: What wheedling (? parirāpín) man thou puttest forward, O niggard, to him of thine we pay homage: do not thou disturb my winning (vaní).

verses.sa:
प्र णो वनिर्देवकृता दिवा नक्तं च कल्पताम् ।
अरातिमनुप्रेमो वयं नमो अस्त्वरातये ॥
verses.rom:
pra no vanirdevakrita diva naktam cha kalpatam |
aratimanupremo vayam namo astvarataye ||
verses.en: Let our god-made winning progress (pra-kḷp) by day and by night; we go forth after the niggard; homage be to the niggard.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीमनुमतिं भगं यन्तो हवामहे ।
वाचं जुष्टां मधुमतीमवादिषं देवानां देवहूतिषु ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvatimanumatim bhagam yanto havamahe |
vacham jushtam madhumatimavadisham devanam devahutishu ||
verses.en: Sarasvatī, Anumati, Bhaga, we going call on; pleasant (juṣṭá) honeyed speech have I spoken in the god-invocations of the gods.

verses.sa:
यं याचाम्यहं वाचा सरस्वत्या मनोयुजा ।
श्रद्धा तमद्य विन्दतु दत्ता सोमेन बभ्रुणा ॥
verses.rom:
yam yachamyaham vacha sarasvatya manoyuja |
shraddha tamadya vindatu datta somena babhruna ||
verses.en: Whomever I solicit (yāc) with speech, with Sarasvatī, mind-yoked, him may faith find today, given by the brown soma.

verses.sa:
मा वनिं मा वाचं नो वीर्त्सीरुभाविन्द्राग्नी आ भरतां नो वसूनि ।
सर्वे नो अद्य दित्सन्तोऽरातिं प्रति हर्यत ॥
verses.rom:
ma vanim ma vacham no virtsirubhavindragni a bharatam no vasuni |
sarve no adya ditsanto'ratim prati haryata ||
verses.en: Do not thou baffle our winning nor speech. Let Indra and Agni both bring good things to us. De ye all, willing today to give to us, welcome the niggard.

verses.sa:
परोऽपेह्यसमृद्धे वि ते हेतिं नयामसि ।
वेद त्वाहं निमीवन्तीं नितुदन्तीमराते ॥
verses.rom:
paro'pehyasamriddhe vi te hetim nayamasi |
veda tvaham nimivantim nitudantimarate ||
verses.en: Go thou far away, O ill-success; we conduct away thy missile; I know thee, O niggard, as one putting (? mīv) down, thrusting down.

verses.sa:
उत नग्ना बोभुवती स्वप्नया सचसे जनम् ।
अराते चित्तं वीर्त्सन्त्याकूतिं पुरुषस्य च ॥
verses.rom:
uta nagna bobhuvati svapnaya sachase janam |
arate chittam virtsantyakutim purushasya cha ||
verses.en: Likewise, greatly making thyself naked, thou fastenest on (sac) a person in dreams, O niggard, baffling the plan and design of a man (púruṣa).

verses.sa:
या महती महोन्माना विश्वा आशा व्यानशे ।
तस्यै हिरण्यकेश्यै निर्ऋत्या अकरं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
ya mahati mahonmana vishva asha vyanashe |
tasyai hiranyakeshyai nirritya akaram namah ||
verses.en: She that, being great, of great height (-unmāna), permeated all regions—to her, the golden-haired, to perdition have I paid homage.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णा सुभगा हिरण्यकशिपुर्मही ।
तस्यै हिरण्यद्रापयेऽरात्या अकरं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyavarna subhaga hiranyakashipurmahi |
tasyai hiranyadrapaye'ratya akaram namah ||
verses.en: Gold-colored, fortunate, gold-cushioned, great—to her, the golden-mantled, to the niggard have I paid homage.

verses.sa:
वैकङ्कतेनेध्मेन देवेभ्य आज्यं वह ।
अग्ने तामिह मादय सर्व आ यन्तु मे हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
vaikankatenedhmena devebhya ajyam vaha |
agne tamiha madaya sarva a yantu me havam ||
verses.en: With fuel of víkan̄kata do thou carry the sacrificial butter to the gods; O Agni, make them revel here; let all come to my call.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा याहि मे हवमिदं करिष्यामि तच्छृणु ।
इम ऐन्द्रा अतिसरा आकूतिं सं नमन्तु मे ।
तेभिः शकेम वीर्यं जातवेदस्तनूवशिन् ॥
verses.rom:
indra yahi me havamidam karishyami tachchhrinu |
ima aindra atisara akutim sam namantu me |
tebhih shakema viryam jatavedastanuvashin ||
verses.en: O Indra, come to my call; this will I do; that hear thou; let these over-runners (? atisará) of Indra's bring to pass (sam-nam) my design; by them may we be equal to (çak) heroism, O Jātavedas, self-controller.

verses.sa:
यदसावमुतो देवा अदेवः संश्चिकीर्षति ।
मा तस्याग्निर्हव्यं वाक्षीद्धवं देवा अस्य मोप गुर्ममैव हवमेतन ॥
verses.rom:
yadasavamuto deva adevah samshchikirshati |
ma tasyagnirhavyam vakshiddhavam deva asya mopa gurmamaiva havametana ||
verses.en: What he there yonder, O gods, being godless, desires to do—let not Agni carry his oblation; let not the gods go to his call; come ye only (evá) unto my call.

verses.sa:
अति धावतातिसरा इन्द्रस्य वचसा हत ।
अविं वृक इव मथ्नीत स वो जीवन् मा मोचि प्राणमस्यापि नह्यत ॥
verses.rom:
ati dhavatatisara indrasya vachasa hata |
avim vrika iva mathnita sa vo jivan ma mochi pranamasyapi nahyata ||
verses.en: Overrun (ati-dhāv), ye over-runners; slay by Indra's spell (vácas); shake (math) ye as a wolf [shakes] a sheep; let him not be released from you alive; shut up his breath.

verses.sa:
यममी पुरोदधिरे ब्रह्माणमपभूतये ।
इन्द्र स ते अधस्पदं तं प्रत्यस्यामि मृत्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
yamami purodadhire brahmanamapabhutaye |
indra sa te adhaspadam tam pratyasyami mrityave ||
verses.en: What brahmán they yonder have put forward for failure (åpabhūti), [be] he beneath thy feet, O Indra; him I cast unto death.

verses.sa:
यदि प्रेयुर्देवपुरा ब्रह्म वर्माणि चक्रिरे ।
तनूपानं परिपाणं कृण्वाना यदुपोचिरे सर्वं तदरसं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
yadi preyurdevapura brahma varmani chakrire |
tanupanam paripanam krinvana yadupochire sarvam tadarasam kridhi ||
verses.en: If they have gone forward to the gods' strongholds (-purā), have made incantation (bráhman) their defenses—if (? yát) making a body-protection, a complete protection, they have encouraged themselves (upa-vac): all that do thou make sapless.

verses.sa:
यान् असावतिसरांश्चकार कृणवच्च यान् ।
त्वं तान् इन्द्र वृत्रहन् प्रतीचः पुनरा कृधि यथामुं तृणहां जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
yan asavatisaramshchakara krinavachcha yan |
tvam tan indra vritrahan pratichah punara kridhi yathamum trinaham janam ||
verses.en: What over-runners he yonder has made, and what he shall make, do thou, O Indra, Vṛtra-slayer, turn (ā-kṛ) them back again, that they may shatter (tṛh) yon person (jána).

verses.sa:
यथेन्द्र उद्वाचनं लब्ध्वा चक्रे अधस्पदम् ।
कृण्वेऽहमधरान् तथा अमूञ्छश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yathendra udvachanam labdhva chakre adhaspadam |
krinve'hamadharan tatha amunchhashvatibhyah samabhyah ||
verses.en: As Indra, taking Udvācana, put [him] underneath his feet, so do I put down them yonder, through everlasting (çáçvat) years (sámā).

verses.sa:
अत्रैनान् इन्द्र वृत्रहन्न् उग्रो मर्मणि विध्य ।
अत्रैवैनान् अभि तिष्ठेन्द्र मेद्यहं तव ।
अनु त्वेन्द्रा रभामहे स्याम सुमतौ तव ॥
verses.rom:
atrainan indra vritrahann ugro marmani vidhya |
atraivainan abhi tishthendra medyaham tava |
anu tvendra rabhamahe syama sumatau tava ||
verses.en: Here, O Indra, Vṛtra-slayer, do thou, formidable, pierce them in the vitals; just here do thou trample upon them; O Indra, thine ally am I; we take hold on thee, O Indra; may we be in thy favor.

verses.sa: दिवे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: dive svaha ||
verses.en: To heaven hail!

verses.sa: पृथिव्यै स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: prithivyai svaha ||
verses.en: To earth hail!

verses.sa: अन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: antarikshaya svaha ||
verses.en: To atmosphere hail!

verses.sa: अन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: antarikshaya svaha ||
verses.en: To atmosphere hail!

verses.sa: दिवे स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: dive svaha ||
verses.en: To heaven hail!

verses.sa: पृथिव्यै स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: prithivyai svaha ||
verses.en: To earth hail!

verses.sa:
सूर्यो मे चक्षुर्वातः प्राणोऽन्तरिक्षमात्मा पृथिवी शरीरम् ।
अस्तृतो नामाहमयमस्मि स आत्मानं नि दधे द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां गोपीथाय ॥
verses.rom:
suryo me chakshurvatah prano'ntarikshamatma prithivi shariram |
astrito namahamayamasmi sa atmanam ni dadhe dyavaprithivibhyam gopithaya ||
verses.en: The sun my eye, wind my breath, atmosphere my soul (ātmán), earth my body; unquelled (astṛtá) by name am I here; [as] such I deposit myself for heaven and earth to guard (gopīthá).

verses.sa:
उदायुरुद्बलमुत्कृतमुत्कृत्यामुन् मनीषामुदिन्द्रियम् ।
आयुष्कृदायुष्पत्नी स्वधावन्तौ गोपा मे स्तं गोपायतं मा ।
आत्मसदौ मे स्तं मा मा हिंसिष्टम् ॥
verses.rom:
udayurudbalamutkritamutkrityamun manishamudindriyam |
ayushkridayushpatni svadhavantau gopa me stam gopayatam ma |
atmasadau me stam ma ma himsishtam ||
verses.en: Up life-time, up strength, up act (kṛtá), up action (kṛtyā́), up skill (manīṣā́), up sense (indriyá); O life- (ā́yus-) maker, O ye (two) mistresses of life, rich in svadhā́m., be ye my guardians, guard me; be my soulsitters; do not harm me.

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मा प्राच्या दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत्स ऋच्छात् ॥
verses.rom:
ashmavarma me'si yo ma prachya disho'ghayurabhidasat|
etatsa richchhat ||
verses.en: My stone-defense art thou; whoever from the eastern quarter, malicious, shall assail me, this may he come upon (ṛch).

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मा दक्षिणाया दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत्स ऋच्छात् ॥
verses.rom:
ashmavarma me'si yo ma dakshinaya disho'ghayurabhidasat|
etatsa richchhat ||
verses.en: My stone-defense art thou; whoever from the southern quarter etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मा प्रतीच्या दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत्स ऋच्छात् ॥
verses.rom:
ashmavarma me'si yo ma pratichya disho'ghayurabhidasat|
etatsa richchhat ||
verses.en: My stone-defense art thou; whoever from the western quarter etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मोदीच्या दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत्स ऋच्छात् ॥
verses.rom:
ashmavarma me'si yo modichya disho'ghayurabhidasat|
etatsa richchhat ||
verses.en: My stone-defense art thou; whoever from the northern quarter etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मा ध्रुवाया दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत्स ऋच्छात् ॥
verses.rom:
ashmavarma me'si yo ma dhruvaya disho'ghayurabhidasat|
etatsa richchhat ||
verses.en: My stone-defense art thou; whoever from the fixed quarter etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मोर्ध्वाया दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत्स ऋच्छात् ॥
verses.rom:
ashmavarma me'si yo mordhvaya disho'ghayurabhidasat|
etatsa richchhat ||
verses.en: My stone-defense art thou; whoever from the upward quarter etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मा दिशामन्तर्देशेभ्योऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत्स ऋच्छात् ॥
verses.rom:
ashmavarma me'si yo ma dishamantardeshebhyo'ghayurabhidasat|
etatsa richchhat ||
verses.en: My stone-defense art thou; whoever from the intermediate quarters of the quarters etc. etc.

verses.sa:
बृहता मन उप ह्वये मातरिश्वना प्राणापानौ ।
सूर्याच्चक्षुरन्तरिक्षाच्छ्रोत्रं पृथिव्याः शरीरम् ।
सरस्वत्या वाचमुप ह्वयामहे मनोयुजा ॥
verses.rom:
brihata mana upa hvaye matarishvana pranapanau |
suryachchakshurantarikshachchhrotram prithivyah shariram |
sarasvatya vachamupa hvayamahe manoyuja ||
verses.en: By the great one (bṛhát) I call unto mind; by Mātariçvan, unto breath and expiration; from the sun [I call] sight, from the atmosphere hearing, from the earth body; by Sarasvatī, mind-yoked, we call unto speech.

verses.sa:
कथं महे असुरायाब्रवीरिह कथं पित्रे हरये त्वेषनृम्णः ।
पृश्निं वरुण दक्षिणां ददावान् पुनर्मघ त्वं मनसाचिकित्सीः ॥
verses.rom:
katham mahe asurayabraviriha katham pitre haraye tveshanrimnah |
prishnim varuna dakshinam dadavan punarmagha tvam manasachikitsih ||
verses.en: How unto the great Asura didst thou speak here? how, with shining manliness, unto the yellow (hári) father? having given, O Varuṇa, a spotted [cow] as sacrificial fee, thou hast with the mind intended (? cikits) re-bestowal (?).

verses.sa:
न कामेन पुनर्मघो भवामि सं चक्षे कं पृश्निमेतामुपाजे ।
केन नु त्वमथर्वन् काव्येन केन जातेनासि जातवेदाः ॥
verses.rom:
na kamena punarmagho bhavami sam chakshe kam prishnimetamupaje |
kena nu tvamatharvan kavyena kena jatenasi jatavedah ||
verses.en: Not at pleasure am I a re-bestower; for examination (?) do I drive home this spotted [cow]; by what poesy (kā́vya) now, O Atharvan, [art] thou [poet]? by what that is produced (jātá) art thou jātávedas?

verses.sa:
सत्यमहं गभीरः काव्येन सत्यं जातेनास्मि जातवेदाः ।
न मे दासो नार्यो महित्वा व्रतं मीमाय यदहं धरिष्ये ॥
verses.rom:
satyamaham gabhirah kavyena satyam jatenasmi jatavedah |
na me daso naryo mahitva vratam mimaya yadaham dharishye ||
verses.en: I verily am profound by poesy; verily by what is produced I am jātávedas; not barbarian (dāsá), not Aryan, by his might, damageth (mī) the course which I shall maintain.

verses.sa:
न त्वदन्यः कवितरो न मेधया धीरतरो वरुण स्वधावन् ।
त्वं ता विश्वा भुवनानि वेत्थ स चिन् नु त्वज्जनो मायी बिभाय ॥
verses.rom:
na tvadanyah kavitaro na medhaya dhirataro varuna svadhavan |
tvam ta vishva bhuvanani vettha sa chin nu tvajjano mayi bibhaya ||
verses.en: None else than thou is more poet, nor by wisdom (medhá) more wise (dhī́ra), O Varuṇa, self-ruling one (svadhā́vant); thou knowest all these beings; even that wily man (jána) now is afraid of thee.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्यङ्ग वरुण स्वधावन् विश्वा वेत्थ जनिम सुप्रणीते ।
किं रजस एना परो अन्यदस्त्येना किं परेणावरममुर ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hyanga varuna svadhavan vishva vettha janima supranite |
kim rajasa ena paro anyadastyena kim parenavaramamura ||
verses.en: Since thou verily, O self-ruling Varuṇa, knowest all births, O well-conducting one—is there anything else beyond the welkin (rájas)? is there anything below what is beyond, O unerring one (? amura)?

verses.sa:
एकं रजस एना परो अन्यदस्त्येना पर एकेन दुर्णशं चिदर्वाक्।
तत्ते विद्वान् वरुण प्र ब्रवीम्यधोवचसः पणयो भवन्तु नीचैर्दासा उप सर्पन्तु भूमिम् ॥
verses.rom:
ekam rajasa ena paro anyadastyena para ekena durnasham chidarvak|
tatte vidvan varuna pra bravimyadhovachasah panayo bhavantu nichairdasa upa sarpantu bhumim ||
verses.en: There is one other thing beyond the welkin; there is something, hard to attain, hitherward from what is beyond: this I Varuṇa, knowing it, proclaim to thee. Be the paṇis of degraded speech; let the barbarians creep (sṛp) downward to the earth.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्यङ्ग वरुण ब्रवीषि पुनर्मघेष्ववद्यानि भूरि ।
मो षु पणींरभ्येतावतो भून् मा त्वा वोचन्न् अराधसं जनासः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hyanga varuna bravishi punarmagheshvavadyani bhuri |
mo shu panimrabhyetavato bhun ma tva vochann aradhasam janasah ||
verses.en: Since thou verily, O Varuṇa, speakest many reproachful things among (as to ?) re-bestowers, do not thou, I pray, belong to (abhi-bhū) such paṇís; let not people call thee ungenerous (arādhás).

verses.sa:
मा मा वोचन्न् अराधसं जनासः पुनस्ते पृश्निं जरितर्ददामि ।
स्तोत्रं मे विश्वमा याहि शचीभिरन्तर्विश्वासु मानुषीषु दिक्षु ॥
verses.rom:
ma ma vochann aradhasam janasah punaste prishnim jaritardadami |
stotram me vishvama yahi shachibhirantarvishvasu manushishu dikshu ||
verses.en: Let not people call me ungenerous; I give thee back the spotted

verses.sa:
आ ते स्तोत्राण्युद्यतानि यन्त्वन्तर्विश्वासु मानुषीषु दिक्षु ।
देहि नु मे यन् मे अदत्तो असि युज्यो मे सप्तपदः सखासि ॥
verses.rom:
a te stotranyudyatani yantvantarvishvasu manushishu dikshu |
dehi nu me yan me adatto asi yujyo me saptapadah sakhasi ||
verses.en: Let uplifted (ud-yam) songs of praise of thee come, among all human regions. Give now to me what thou hast not given me; thou art my suitable comrade of seven steps;—

verses.sa:
समा नौ बन्धुर्वरुण समा जा वेदाहं तद्यन् नावेषा समा जा ।
ददामि तद्यत्ते अदत्तो अस्मि युज्यस्ते सप्तपदः सखास्मि ॥
verses.rom:
sama nau bandhurvaruna sama ja vedaham tadyan navesha sama ja |
dadami tadyatte adatto asmi yujyaste saptapadah sakhasmi ||
verses.en: Of us two, O Varuṇa, [there is] the same connection, the same birth (jā́).

verses.sa:
देवो देवाय गृणते वयोधा विप्रो विप्राय स्तुवते सुमेधाः ।
अजीजनो हि वरुण स्वधावन्न् अथर्वाणं पितरं देवबन्धुम् ।
तस्मा उ राधः कृणुहि सुप्रशस्तं सखा नो असि परमं च बन्धुः ॥
verses.rom:
devo devaya grinate vayodha vipro vipraya stuvate sumedhah |
ajijano hi varuna svadhavann atharvanam pitaram devabandhum |
tasma u radhah krinuhi suprashastam sakha no asi paramam cha bandhuh ||
verses.en: A god, bestower of vigor on a singing god; a sage (vípra), of good wisdom for a praising sage.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अद्य मनुषो दुरोणे देवो देवान् यजसि जातवेदः ।
आ च वह मित्रमहश्चिकित्वान् त्वं दूतः कविरसि प्रचेताः ॥
verses.rom:
samiddho adya manusho durone devo devan yajasi jatavedah |
a cha vaha mitramahashchikitvan tvam dutah kavirasi prachetah ||

verses.sa:
तनूनपात्पथ ऋतस्य यानान् मध्वा समञ्जन्त्स्वदया सुजिह्व ।
मन्मानि धीभिरुत यज्ञमृन्धन् देवत्रा च कृणुह्यध्वरं नः ॥
verses.rom:
tanunapatpatha ritasya yanan madhva samanjantsvadaya sujihva |
manmani dhibhiruta yajnamrindhan devatra cha krinuhyadhvaram nah ||

verses.sa:
आजुह्वान ईड्यो वन्द्यश्चा याह्यग्ने वसुभिः सजोषाः ।
त्वं देवानामसि यह्व होता स एनान् यक्षीषितो यजीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
ajuhvana idyo vandyashcha yahyagne vasubhih sajoshah |
tvam devanamasi yahva hota sa enan yakshishito yajiyan ||

verses.sa:
प्राचीनं बर्हिः प्रदिशा पृथिव्या वस्तोरस्या वृज्यते अग्रे अह्नाम् ।
व्यु प्रथते वितरं वरीयो देवेभ्यो अदितये स्योनम् ॥
verses.rom:
prachinam barhih pradisha prithivya vastorasya vrijyate agre ahnam |
vyu prathate vitaram variyo devebhyo aditaye syonam ||

verses.sa:
व्यचस्वतीरुर्विया वि श्रयन्तां पतिभ्यो न जनयः शुम्भमानाः ।
देवीर्द्वारो बृहतीर्विश्वमिन्वा देवेभ्यो भवत सुप्रायणाः ॥
verses.rom:
vyachasvatirurviya vi shrayantam patibhyo na janayah shumbhamanah |
devirdvaro brihatirvishvaminva devebhyo bhavata suprayanah ||

verses.sa:
आ सुष्वयन्ती यजते उपाके उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ ।
दिव्ये योषणे बृहती सुरुक्मे अधि श्रियं शुक्रपिशं दधाने ॥
verses.rom:
a sushvayanti yajate upake ushasanakta sadatam ni yonau |
divye yoshane brihati surukme adhi shriyam shukrapisham dadhane ||

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा सुवाचा मिमाना यज्ञं मनुषो यजध्यै ।
प्रचोदयन्ता विदथेषु कारू प्राचीनं ज्योतिः प्रदिशा दिशन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
daivya hotara prathama suvacha mimana yajnam manusho yajadhyai |
prachodayanta vidatheshu karu prachinam jyotih pradisha dishanta ||

verses.sa:
आ नो यज्ञं भारती तूयमेत्विडा मनुष्वदिह चेतयन्ती ।
तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं स्योनं सरस्वतीः स्वपसः सदन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
a no yajnam bharati tuyametvida manushvadiha chetayanti |
tisro devirbarhiredam syonam sarasvatih svapasah sadantam ||

verses.sa:
य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जनित्री रूपैरपिंशद्भुवनानि विश्वा ।
तमद्य होतरिषितो यजीयान् देवं त्वष्टारमिह यक्षि विद्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
ya ime dyavaprithivi janitri rupairapimshadbhuvanani vishva |
tamadya hotarishito yajiyan devam tvashtaramiha yakshi vidvan ||

verses.sa:
उपावसृज त्मन्या समञ्जन् देवानां पाथ ऋतुथा हवींषि ।
वनस्पतिः शमिता देवो अग्निः स्वदन्तु हव्यं मधुना घृतेन ॥
verses.rom:
upavasrija tmanya samanjan devanam patha ritutha havimshi |
vanaspatih shamita devo agnih svadantu havyam madhuna ghritena ||

verses.sa:
सद्यो जातो व्यमिमीत यज्ञमग्निर्देवानामभवत्पुरोगाः ।
अस्य होतुः प्रशिष्यृतस्य वाचि स्वाहाकृतं हविरदन्तु देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
sadyo jato vyamimita yajnamagnirdevanamabhavatpurogah |
asya hotuh prashishyritasya vachi svahakritam haviradantu devah ||

prose.en:
1. Kindled this day in the home of man (mánus), thou, a god, O Jātavedas, dost sacrifice to the gods; and do thou bring [them], understanding it, O thou of friendly might; thou art a forethoughtful messenger, poet.

2. O Tanūnapāt (son of thyself?), do thou, anointing with honey (mádhu) the roads that go to righteousness (ṛtá), sweeten them, O well-tongued one; prospering (ṛdh) with prayers (did) the devotions (mánman) and the sacrifice, put (kṛ) thou also among the gods our service (adhvará).

3. Making oblation do thou, O Agni, to be praised and to be greeted, come in accord with the Vasus. Thou art invoker (hótṛ) of the gods, O youthful one (? yahvá); do thou, sent forth, skilled sacrificer (yájīyaṅs), sacrifice to them.

4. The forward barhís, through the fore-region of the earth, is wreathed on this dawn (vástu), at the beginning (ágra) of the days; it spreads out abroad more widely, pleasant to the gods, to Aditi.

5. Expansive let them open (vi-çri) widely, like wives adorned for their husbands; ye great, divine, all-furthering doors, be ye favorable to the advance of the gods.

6. Let Dawn and Night, dripping (? suṣvay-), worshipful, close, sit down here in the lair (yóni)—the two heavenly, great, well-shining women, putting on beauty (çrī́) with bright adornment.

7. The (two) invokers of the gods, first, well-voiced, shaping (mā) the sacrifice for man (mánus) to sacrifice, urging forward at the councils (vidátha) the (two) singers (kārú), pointing out forward light through the fore-region.

8. Unto our sacrifice let Bhāratī come quickly, let Iḍā, taking note here in human fashion; let the three goddesses, well-working, sit upon this pleasant barhís—[also] Sarasvatī.

9. To him, god Tvashṭar, who adorned (piç) with forms these two generatresses, heaven-and-earth, [and] all existences, do thou today, O invoker, sent forth, skilled sacrificer, sacrifice here, understanding it.

10. In thy way (? tmányā) anointing them, pour thou down upon (upa-ava-sṛj) the track of the gods the oblations in due season; let the forest-tree, the queller (çamitár), god Agni, relish (svad) the oblation with honey, with ghee.

12. At once, when born, he determined (vi-mā) the sacrifice; Agni became foremost of the gods; at the direction of this invoker, at the voice of righteousness (ṛtá), let the gods eat the oblation made with "hail!"

verses.sa:
ददिर्हि मह्यं वरुणो दिवः कविर्वचोभिरुग्रैर्नि रिणामि ते विषम् ।
खातमखातमुत सक्तमग्रभमिरेव धन्वन् नि जजास ते विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
dadirhi mahyam varuno divah kavirvachobhirugrairni rinami te visham |
khatamakhatamuta saktamagrabhamireva dhanvan ni jajasa te visham ||
verses.en: Since Varuṇa, poet of heaven, hath given [them] to me, with formidable spells (vácas) do I dissolve thy poison; what is dug, undug, and attached (saktá) have I seized; like drink (írā) on a waste hath thy poison been wasted (ni-jas).

verses.sa:
यत्ते अपोदकं विषं तत्त एतास्वग्रभम् ।
गृह्णामि ते मध्यममुत्तमं रसमुतावमं भियसा नेशदादु ते ॥
verses.rom:
yatte apodakam visham tatta etasvagrabham |
grihnami te madhyamamuttamam rasamutavamam bhiyasa neshadadu te ||
verses.en: What waterless poison is thine, that of thine have I seized in these; I seize thy midmost, thine upmost juice (rása); also may thy lowest then disappear for fright.

verses.sa:
वृषा मे रवो नभसा न तन्यतुरुग्रेण ते वचसा बाध आदु ते ।
अहं तमस्य नृभिरग्रभं रसं तमस इव ज्योतिरुदेतु सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha me ravo nabhasa na tanyaturugrena te vachasa badha adu te |
aham tamasya nribhiragrabham rasam tamasa iva jyotirudetu suryah ||
verses.en: A bull [is] my cry, like thunder through the cloud (nábhas); with thy formidable spell do I then drive it off (bādh) for thee; I have seized that juice of his with men ?; like light out of darkness let the sun arise.

verses.sa:
चक्षुषा ते चक्षुर्हन्मि विषेण हन्मि ते विषम् ।
अहे म्रियस्व मा जीवीः प्रत्यगभ्येतु त्वा विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
chakshusha te chakshurhanmi vishena hanmi te visham |
ahe mriyasva ma jivih pratyagabhyetu tva visham ||
verses.en: With sight I smite thy sight; with poison I smite thy poison; die, O snake, do not live; let thy poison go back against thee.

verses.sa:
कैरात पृश्न उपतृण्य बभ्र आ मे शृणुतासिता अलीकाः ।
मा मे सख्युः स्तामानमपि ष्ठाताश्रावयन्तो नि विषे रमध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
kairata prishna upatrinya babhra a me shrinutasita alikah |
ma me sakhyuh stamanamapi shthatashravayanto ni vishe ramadhvam ||
verses.en: O Kirātan, O spotted one, O grass-haunter (?), O brown one! listen ye to me, O black serpents, offensive ones! stand ye not upon the track (? stāmán) of my comrade; calling out (ā-çrāvay), rest quiet in poison.

verses.sa:
असितस्य तैमातस्य बभ्रोरपोदकस्य च ।
सात्रासाहस्याहं मन्योरव ज्यामिव धन्वनो वि मुञ्चामि रथामिव ॥
verses.rom:
asitasya taimatasya babhrorapodakasya cha |
satrasahasyaham manyorava jyamiva dhanvano vi munchami rathamiva ||
verses.en: Of the Timātan (?) black serpent, of the brown, and of the waterless, of the altogether powerful (?), I relax the fury, as the bow-string of a bow; I release as it were chariots.

verses.sa:
आलिगी च विलिगी च पिता च माता च ।
विद्म वः सर्वतो बन्ध्वरसाः किं करिष्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
aligi cha viligi cha pita cha mata cha |
vidma vah sarvato bandhvarasah kim karishyatha ||
verses.en: Both ā́ligī and víligī, both father and mother—we know your connection (bándhu) completely; sapless ones, what will ye do?

verses.sa:
उरुगूलाया दुहिता जाता दास्यसिक्न्या ।
प्रतङ्कं दद्रुषीणां सर्वासामरसं विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
urugulaya duhita jata dasyasiknya |
pratankam dadrushinam sarvasamarasam visham ||
verses.en: Daughter of the broad-knobbed one (?), born of the black barbarian (f.)—of all them (f.) that have pierced defiantly (?) the poison [is] sapless.

verses.sa:
कर्णा श्वावित्तदब्रवीद्गिरेरवचरन्तिका ।
याः काश्चेमाः खनित्रिमास्तासामरसतमं विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
karna shvavittadabravidgireravacharantika |
yah kashchemah khanitrimastasamarasatamam visham ||
verses.en: The eared hedgehog said this, coming down from the mountain: whichsoever of these (f.) are produced by digging, of them the poison is most sapless.

verses.sa:
ताबुवं न ताबुवं न घेत्त्वमसि ताबुवम् ।
ताबुवेनारसं विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
tabuvam na tabuvam na ghettvamasi tabuvam |
tabuvenarasam visham ||
verses.en: Tābúva, not tābúva; verily thou art not tābúva; by tābúva [is] the poison sapless.

verses.sa:
तस्तुवं न तस्तुवं न घेत्त्वमसि तस्तुवम् ।
तस्तुवेनारसं विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
tastuvam na tastuvam na ghettvamasi tastuvam |
tastuvenarasam visham ||
verses.en: Tastúva, not tastúva; verily thou art not tastúva; by tastúva [is] the poison sapless.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णस्त्वान्वविन्दत्सूकरस्त्वाखनन् नसा ।
दिप्सौषधे त्वं दिप्सन्तमव कृत्याकृतं जहि ॥
verses.rom:
suparnastvanvavindatsukarastvakhanan nasa |
dipsaushadhe tvam dipsantamava krityakritam jahi ||
verses.en: An eagle (suparṇá) discovered thee; a hog dug thee with his snout; seek thou to injure, O herb, him that seeks to injure; smite down the witchcraft-maker.

verses.sa:
अव जहि यातुधानान् अव कृत्याकृतं जहि ।
अथो यो अस्मान् दिप्सति तमु त्वं जह्योषधे ॥
verses.rom:
ava jahi yatudhanan ava krityakritam jahi |
atho yo asman dipsati tamu tvam jahyoshadhe ||
verses.en: Smite down the sorcerers, smite down the witchcraft-maker; then, whoever seeks to injure us, him do thou smite, O herb.

verses.sa:
रिश्यस्येव परीशासं परिकृत्य परि त्वचः ।
कृत्यां कृत्याकृते देवा निष्कमिव प्रति मुञ्चत ॥
verses.rom:
rishyasyeva parishasam parikritya pari tvachah |
krityam krityakrite deva nishkamiva prati munchata ||
verses.en: Having cut around out of [his] skin a strip (pariçāsá), as it were of a stag, fasten, O gods, upon the witchcraft-maker the witchcraft, like a necklace.

verses.sa:
पुनः कृत्यां कृत्याकृते हस्तगृह्य परा णय ।
समक्षमस्मा आ धेहि यथा कृत्याकृतं हनत् ॥
verses.rom:
punah krityam krityakrite hastagrihya para naya |
samakshamasma a dhehi yatha krityakritam hanat ||
verses.en: Lead thou away the witchcraft back to the witchcraft-maker, grasping its hand; set it straight before (samakṣám) him, that it may smite the witchcraft-maker.

verses.sa:
कृत्याः सन्तु कृत्याकृते शपथः शपथीयते ।
सुखो रथ इव वर्ततां कृत्या कृत्याकृतं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
krityah santu krityakrite shapathah shapathiyate |
sukho ratha iva vartatam kritya krityakritam punah ||
verses.en: Be the witchcrafts for the witchcraft-maker, the curse for him that curses; like an easy chariot let the witchcraft roll back to the witchcraft-maker.

verses.sa:
यदि स्त्री यदि वा पुमान् कृत्यां चकार पाप्मने ।
तामु तस्मै नयामस्यश्वमिवाश्वाभिधान्या ॥
verses.rom:
yadi stri yadi va puman krityam chakara papmane |
tamu tasmai nayamasyashvamivashvabhidhanya ||
verses.en: If woman, or if man, hath made witchcraft in order to evil, it we conduct unto him, like a horse by a horse-halter.

verses.sa:
यदि वासि देवकृता यदि वा पुरुषैः कृता ।
तां त्वा पुनर्णयामसीन्द्रेण सयुजा वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadi vasi devakrita yadi va purushaih krita |
tam tva punarnayamasindrena sayuja vayam ||
verses.en: If either thou art god-made, or if made by man, thee, being such, do we lead back, with Indra as ally.

verses.sa:
अग्ने पृतनाषाट्पृतनाः सहस्व ।
पुनः कृत्यां कृत्याकृते प्रतिहरणेन हरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
agne pritanashatpritanah sahasva |
punah krityam krityakrite pratiharanena haramasi ||
verses.en: O Agni, overpowerer of fighters, overpower the fighters; we take the witchcraft back to the witchcraft-maker by a returner.

verses.sa:
कृतव्यधनि विध्य तं यश्चकार तमिज्जहि ।
न त्वामचक्रुषे वयं वधाय सं शिशीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
kritavyadhani vidhya tam yashchakara tamijjahi |
na tvamachakrushe vayam vadhaya sam shishimahi ||
verses.en: O practiced piercer (?), pierce him; whoever made [it], him do thou smite; we do not sharpen thee up to slay (vadhá) him who has not made [it].

verses.sa:
पुत्र इव पितरं गच्छ स्वज इवाभिष्ठितो दश ।
बन्धमिवावक्रामी गच्छ कृत्ये कृत्याकृतं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
putra iva pitaram gachchha svaja ivabhishthito dasha |
bandhamivavakrami gachchha kritye krityakritam punah ||
verses.en: Go as a son to a father; like a constrictor trampled on, bite; go, O witchcraft, back to the witchcraft-maker, as it were treading down [thy] bond.

verses.sa:
उदेणीव वारण्यभिस्कन्दं मृगीव ।
कृत्या कर्तारमृच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
udeniva varanyabhiskandam mrigiva |
kritya kartaramrichchhatu ||
verses.en: Up, like a she-antelope (eṇī́), a she-elephant (? vāraṇī́), with leaping on, like a hind, let the witchcraft go to its maker.

verses.sa:
इष्वा ऋजीयः पततु द्यावापृथिवी तं प्रति ।
सा तं मृगमिव गृह्णातु कृत्या कृत्याकृतं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
ishva rijiyah patatu dyavaprithivi tam prati |
sa tam mrigamiva grihnatu kritya krityakritam punah ||
verses.en: Straighter than an arrow let it fly, O heaven-and-earth, to meet him; let it, the witchcraft, seize again him, the witchcraft-maker, like a deer.

verses.sa:
अग्निरिवैतु प्रतिकूलमनुकूलमिवोदकम् ।
सुखो रथ इव वर्ततां कृत्या कृत्याकृतं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirivaitu pratikulamanukulamivodakam |
sukho ratha iva vartatam kritya krityakritam punah ||
verses.en: Let it go like fire up-stream, like water down-stream; like an easyc hariot let the witchcraft roll back to the witchcraft-maker.

verses.sa:
एका च मे दश च मेऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
eka cha me dasha cha me'pavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both one of me and ten of me [are] the exorcisers (apavaktár), O herb; thou born of right (ṛtá), thou rich in right, mayest thou, honeyed (madhulā́), make honey for me.

verses.sa:
द्वे च मे विंशतिश्च मेऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
dve cha me vimshatishcha me'pavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both two of me and twenty of me [are] etc. etc.

verses.sa:
तिस्रश्च मे त्रिंशच्च मेऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
tisrashcha me trimshachcha me'pavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both three of me and thirty of me [are] etc. etc.

verses.sa:
चतस्रश्च मे चत्वारिंशच्च मेऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
chatasrashcha me chatvarimshachcha me'pavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both four of me and forty of me [are] etc. etc.

verses.sa:
पञ्च च मे पञ्चाशच्च मेऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
pancha cha me panchashachcha me'pavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both five of me and fifty of me [are] etc. etc.

verses.sa:
षट्च मे षष्टिश्च मेऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
shatcha me shashtishcha me'pavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both six of me and sixty of me [are] etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सप्त च मे सप्ततिश्च मेऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
sapta cha me saptatishcha me'pavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both seven of me and seventy of me [are] etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अष्ट च मेऽशीतिश्च मेऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
ashta cha me'shitishcha me'pavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both eight of me and eighty of me [are] etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नव च मे नवतिश्च मेऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
nava cha me navatishcha me'pavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both nine of me and ninety of me [are] etc. etc.

verses.sa:
दश च मे शतं च मेऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
dasha cha me shatam cha me'pavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both ten of me and a hundred of me [are] etc. etc.

verses.sa:
शतं च मे सहस्रं चापवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः ॥
verses.rom:
shatam cha me sahasram chapavaktara oshadhe |
ritajata ritavari madhu me madhula karah ||
verses.en: Both a hundred of me and a thousand [are] the exorcisers, O herb; etc. etc.

verses.sa: यद्येकवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadyekavrisho'si srijaraso'si ||
verses.en: If thou art sole chief, let go; sapless art thou.

verses.sa: यदि द्विवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadi dvivrisho'si srijaraso'si ||
verses.en: If thou art twice chief etc. etc.

verses.sa: यदि त्रिवृसोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadi trivriso'si srijaraso'si ||
verses.en: If thou art thrice chief etc. etc.

verses.sa: यदि चतुर्वृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadi chaturvrisho'si srijaraso'si ||
verses.en: If thou art four times chief etc. etc.

verses.sa: यदि पञ्चवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadi panchavrisho'si srijaraso'si ||
verses.en: If thou art five times chief etc. etc.

verses.sa: यदि षड्वृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadi shadvrisho'si srijaraso'si ||
verses.en: If thou art six times chief etc. etc.

verses.sa: यदि सप्तवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadi saptavrisho'si srijaraso'si ||
verses.en: If thou art seven times chief etc. etc.

verses.sa: यद्यष्टवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadyashtavrisho'si srijaraso'si ||
verses.en: If thou art eight times chief etc. etc.

verses.sa: यदि नववृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadi navavrisho'si srijaraso'si ||
verses.en: If thou art nine times chief etc. etc.

verses.sa: यदि दशवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadi dashavrisho'si srijaraso'si ||
verses.en: If thou art ten times chief etc. etc.

verses.sa: यद्येकादशोऽसि सोऽपोदकोऽसि ॥
verses.rom: yadyekadasho'si so'podako'si ||
verses.en: If thou art eleven-fold, then thou art waterless.

verses.sa:
तेऽवदन् प्रथमा ब्रह्मकिल्बिषेऽकूपारः सलिलो मातरिश्वा ।
वीडुहरास्तप उग्रं मयोभूरापो देवीः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
te'vadan prathama brahmakilbishe'kuparah salilo matarishva |
viduharastapa ugram mayobhurapo devih prathamaja ritasya ||
verses.en: These spoke first at the offense against the Brahman (bráhman-): the boundless sea, Mātariçvan, he of stout rage (-háras), formidable fervor, the kindly one, the heavenly waters, first-born of right (ṛtá).

verses.sa:
सोमो राजा प्रथमो ब्रह्मजायां पुनः प्रायच्छदहृणीयमानः ।
अन्वर्तिता वरुणो मित्र आसीदग्निर्होता हस्तगृह्या निनाय ॥
verses.rom:
somo raja prathamo brahmajayam punah prayachchhadahriniyamanah |
anvartita varuno mitra asidagnirhota hastagrihya ninaya ||
verses.en: King Soma first gave (pra-yam) back the Brahman's wife, not bearing enmity; he who went after [her] was Varuṇa, Mitra; Agni, invoker, conducted [her] hither, seizing her hand.

verses.sa:
हस्तेनैव ग्राह्य आधिरस्या ब्रह्मजायेति चेदवोचत्।
न दूताय प्रहेया तस्थ एषा तथा राष्ट्रं गुपितं क्षत्रियस्य ॥
verses.rom:
hastenaiva grahya adhirasya brahmajayeti chedavochat|
na dutaya praheya tastha esha tatha rashtram gupitam kshatriyasya ||
verses.en: To be seized by the hand indeed is the pledge (? ādhí) of her, if one has said "[she is] the Brahman's wife"; she stood not to be sent forth for a messenger: so is made safe (gupitá) the kingdom of the Kshatriya.}}

verses.sa:
यामाहुस्तारकैषा विकेशीति दुच्छुनां ग्राममवपद्यमानाम् ।
सा ब्रह्मजाया वि दुनोति राष्ट्रं यत्र प्रापादि शश उल्कुषीमान् ॥
verses.rom:
yamahustarakaisha vikeshiti duchchhunam gramamavapadyamanam |
sa brahmajaya vi dunoti rashtram yatra prapadi shasha ulkushiman ||
verses.en: The misfortune, descending (ava-pad) upon the village, of which they say "this is a star with disheveled hair"—as such, the Brahman's wife burns up the kingdom, where hath gone forth a hare (? çaçá) accompanied with meteors (ulkuṣī́-).

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारी चरति वेविषद्विषः स देवानां भवत्येकमङ्गम् ।
तेन जायामन्वविन्दद्बृहस्पतिः सोमेन नीतां जुह्वं न देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmachari charati vevishadvishah sa devanam bhavatyekamangam |
tena jayamanvavindadbrihaspatih somena nitam juhvam na devah ||
verses.en: The Vedic student (brahmacārin) goes about serving (viṣ) much service; he becomes one limb of the gods; by him Brihaspati discovered the wife, conducted by Soma, like the sacrificial spoon, O gods.

verses.sa:
देवा वा एतस्यामवदन्त पूर्वे सप्तऋषयस्तपसा ये निषेदुः ।
भीमा जाया ब्राह्मणस्यापनीता दुर्धां दधाति परमे व्योमन् ॥
verses.rom:
deva va etasyamavadanta purve saptarishayastapasa ye nisheduh |
bhima jaya brahmanasyapanita durdham dadhati parame vyoman ||
verses.en: The gods of old verily spoke about her, the seven seers who sat down with penance (tápas); fearful [is] the wife of the Brahman when led away; she makes (dhā) discomfort (durdhā́) in the highest firmament (vyòman).

verses.sa:
ये गर्भा अवपद्यन्ते जगद्यच्चापलुप्यते ।
वीरा ये तृह्यन्ते मिथो ब्रह्मजाया हिनस्ति तान् ॥
verses.rom:
ye garbha avapadyante jagadyachchapalupyate |
vira ye trihyante mitho brahmajaya hinasti tan ||
verses.en: What embryos are aborted (ava-pad), what living creatures (jágat) are torn away (apa-lup), what heroes are mutually shattered—them the Brahman's wife injures.

verses.sa:
उत यत्पतयो दश स्त्रियाः पूर्वे अब्राह्मणाः ।
ब्रह्मा चेद्धस्तमग्रहीत्स एव पतिरेकधा ॥
verses.rom:
uta yatpatayo dasha striyah purve abrahmanah |
brahma cheddhastamagrahitsa eva patirekadha ||
verses.en: And if [there were] ten former husbands of a woman, not Brahmans—provided a Brahman has seized her hand, he is alone her husband.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मण एव पतिर्न राजन्यो न वैश्यः ।
तत्सूर्यः प्रब्रुवन्न् एति पञ्चभ्यो मानवेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmana eva patirna rajanyo na vaishyah |
tatsuryah prabruvann eti panchabhyo manavebhyah ||
verses.en: A Brahman [is] indeed her husband, not a noble (rājanyà), not a Vāiçya: this the sun goes proclaiming to the five races of men (mānavá).

verses.sa:
पुनर्वै देवा अददुः पुनर्मनुष्या अददुः ।
राजानः सत्यं गृह्णाना ब्रह्मजायां पुनर्ददुः ॥
verses.rom:
punarvai deva adaduh punarmanushya adaduh |
rajanah satyam grihnana brahmajayam punardaduh ||
verses.en: The gods verily gave back; men (manuṣyà) gave back; kings, apprehending (grah) truth, gave back the Brahman's wife.

verses.sa:
पुनर्दाय ब्रह्मजायां कृत्वा देवैर्निकिल्बिषम् ।
ऊर्जं पृथिव्या भक्त्वोरुगायमुपासते ॥
verses.rom:
punardaya brahmajayam kritva devairnikilbisham |
urjam prithivya bhaktvorugayamupasate ||
verses.en: Having given back the Brahman's wife, having brought about (kṛ) freedom of offense with the gods, sharing (bhaj) the refreshment (ū́rj) of the earth, they occupy (upa-ās) broad space (urugyá).

verses.sa:
नास्य जाया शतवाही कल्याणी तल्पमा शये ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
nasya jaya shatavahi kalyani talpama shaye |
yasmin rashtre nirudhyate brahmajayachittya ||
verses.en: Not on his couch lies a beautiful hundred-bringing (-vāhī́) wife, in whose kingdom the Brahman's wife is obstructed through ignorance.

verses.sa:
न विकर्णः पृथुशिरास्तस्मिन् वेश्मनि जायते ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
na vikarnah prithushirastasmin veshmani jayate |
yasmin rashtre nirudhyate brahmajayachittya ||
verses.en: A wide-eared, broad-headed [ox?] is not born in that dwelling, in whose etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नास्य क्षत्ता निष्कग्रीवः सूनानामेत्यग्रतः ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
nasya kshatta nishkagrivah sunanametyagratah |
yasmin rashtre nirudhyate brahmajayachittya ||
verses.en: A distributer (kṣattár) with necklaced neck goes not at the head of his crates (? sūnā́) [of food], in whose etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नास्य श्वेतः कृष्णकर्णो धुरि युक्तो महीयते ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
nasya shvetah krishnakarno dhuri yukto mahiyate |
yasmin rashtre nirudhyate brahmajayachittya ||
verses.en: A white, black-eared [horse] does not make a show (mahīy), harnessed to his [chariot-] pole, in whose etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नास्य क्षेत्रे पुष्करिणी नाण्डीकं जायते बिसम् ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
nasya kshetre pushkarini nandikam jayate bisam |
yasmin rashtre nirudhyate brahmajayachittya ||
verses.en: Not in his field [is] a lotus-pond, the bulb (? bísa) of the bulb-bearing lotus is not produced (jan), in whose etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नास्मै पृश्निं वि दुहन्ति येऽस्या दोहमुपासते ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
nasmai prishnim vi duhanti ye'sya dohamupasate |
yasmin rashtre nirudhyate brahmajayachittya ||
verses.en: Not for him do they who attend to (upa-ās) her milking milk out the spotted [cow], in whose etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नास्य धेनुः कल्याणी नानड्वान्त्सहते धुरम् ।
विजानिर्यत्र ब्राह्मणो रात्रिं वसति पापया ॥
verses.rom:
nasya dhenuh kalyani nanadvantsahate dhuram |
vijaniryatra brahmano ratrim vasati papaya ||
verses.en: Not his [is] a beautiful milch-cow, [his] draft-ox endures not the pole, where a Brahman stays a night miserably (pāpáyā) without a wife (-jāni).

verses.sa:
नैतां ते देवा अददुस्तुभ्यं नृपते अत्तवे ।
मा ब्राह्मणस्य राजन्य गां जिघत्सो अनाद्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
naitam te deva adadustubhyam nripate attave |
ma brahmanasya rajanya gam jighatso anadyam ||
verses.en: Her the gods did not give thee for thee to eat, O lord of men (nṛpáti); do not thou, O noble, desire to devour (ghas) the cow of the Brahman, that is not to be eaten.

verses.sa:
अक्षद्रुग्धो राजन्यः पाप आत्मपराजितः ।
स ब्राह्मणस्य गामद्यादद्य जीवानि मा श्वः ॥
verses.rom:
akshadrugdho rajanyah papa atmaparajitah |
sa brahmanasya gamadyadadya jivani ma shvah ||
verses.en: A noble hated of the dice, evil, self-ruined (-párājita)—he may eat the cow of the Brahman: "let me live today, not tomorrow."

verses.sa:
आविष्टिताघविषा पृदाकूरिव चर्मणा ।
सा ब्राह्मणस्य राजन्य तृष्टैषा गौरनाद्या ॥
verses.rom:
avishtitaghavisha pridakuriva charmana |
sa brahmanasya rajanya trishtaisha gauranadya ||
verses.en: Like an ill-poisonous adder enveloped with [cow-] hide, this cow of the Brahman, O noble, is harsh, not to be eaten.

verses.sa:
निर्वै क्षत्रं नयति हन्ति वर्चोऽग्निरिवारब्धो वि दुनोति सर्वम् ।
यो ब्राह्मणं मन्यते अन्नमेव स विषस्य पिबति तैमातस्य ॥
verses.rom:
nirvai kshatram nayati hanti varcho'gnirivarabdho vi dunoti sarvam |
yo brahmanam manyate annameva sa vishasya pibati taimatasya ||
verses.en: Verily it conducts away his authority, smites his splendor; like fire taken hold of it burns up all; he who thinks the Brahman to be food, he drinks of Timātan poison.

verses.sa:
य एनं हन्ति मृदुं मन्यमानो देवपीयुर्धनकामो न चित्तात्।
सं तस्येन्द्रो हृदयेऽग्निमिन्धे उभे एनं द्विष्टो नभसी चरन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya enam hanti mridum manyamano devapiyurdhanakamo na chittat|
sam tasyendro hridaye'gnimindhe ubhe enam dvishto nabhasi charantam ||
verses.en: Whatever insulter of the gods, desirous of riches, not from knowledge, slays him, thinking him gentle, in his heart Indra kindles a fire; both the firmaments (nábhas) hate him as he goes about.

verses.sa:
न ब्राह्मणो हिंसितव्योऽग्निः प्रियतनोरिव ।
सोमो ह्यस्य दायाद इन्द्रो अस्याभिशस्तिपाः ॥
verses.rom:
na brahmano himsitavyo'gnih priyatanoriva |
somo hyasya dayada indro asyabhishastipah ||
verses.en: The Brahman is not to be injured, like fire, by one who holds himself dear; for Soma is his heir, Indra his protector against imprecation.

verses.sa:
शतापाष्ठां नि गिरति तां न शक्नोति निःखिदम् ।
अन्नं यो ब्रह्मणां मल्वः स्वाद्वद्मीति मन्यते ॥
verses.rom:
shatapashtham ni girati tam na shaknoti nihkhidam |
annam yo brahmanam malvah svadvadmiti manyate ||
verses.en: He swallows down what (f.) has a hundred barbs; he is not able to tear it out—the fool who thinks of the food of Brahmans "I am eating what is sweet."

verses.sa:
जिह्वा ज्या भवति कुल्मलं वाङ्नाडीका दन्तास्तपसाभिदिग्धाः ।
तेभिर्ब्रह्मा विध्यति देवपीयून् हृद्बलैर्धनुर्भिर्देवजूतैः ॥
verses.rom:
jihva jya bhavati kulmalam vannadika dantastapasabhidigdhah |
tebhirbrahma vidhyati devapiyun hridbalairdhanurbhirdevajutaih ||
verses.en: His tongue becomes a bow-string, his voice an [arrow-] neck, his teeth [become] shafts (nāḍīkā́) smeared with penance; with these the Brahman (brahmán) pierces the insulters of the gods, with bows having force from the heart [and] speeded by the gods.

verses.sa:
तीक्ष्णेषवो ब्राह्मणा हेतिमन्तो यामस्यन्ति शरव्यां न सा मृषा ।
अनुहाय तपसा मन्युना चोत दूरादव भिन्दन्त्येनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tikshneshavo brahmana hetimanto yamasyanti sharavyam na sa mrisha |
anuhaya tapasa manyuna chota duradava bhindantyenam ||
verses.en: The Brahmans have sharp arrows, have missiles; what volley (çaravyā̀) they hurl, it is not in vain; pursuing (anu-hā) with fervor and with fury, they split him down even from afar.

verses.sa:
ये सहस्रमराजन्न् आसन् दशशता उत ।
ते ब्राह्मणस्य गां जग्ध्वा वैतहव्याः पराभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
ye sahasramarajann asan dashashata uta |
te brahmanasya gam jagdhva vaitahavyah parabhavan ||
verses.en: They that ruled, a thousand, and were ten hundreds, those Vāitahavyas, having devoured the cow of the Brahman, perished (parā-bhū).

verses.sa:
गौरेव तान् हन्यमाना वैतहव्यामवातिरत्।
ये केसरप्राबन्धायाश्चरमाजामपेचिरन् ॥
verses.rom:
gaureva tan hanyamana vaitahavyamavatirat|
ye kesaraprabandhayashcharamajamapechiran ||
verses.en: The cow herself, being slain, pulled down those Vāitahavyas, who cooked the last she-goat of Kesaraprābandhā (?).

verses.sa:
एकशतं ता जनता या भूमिर्व्यधूनुत ।
प्रजां हिंसित्वा ब्राह्मणीमसंभव्यं पराभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
ekashatam ta janata ya bhumirvyadhunuta |
prajam himsitva brahmanimasambhavyam parabhavan ||
verses.en: Those hundred and one fellows (? janátā) whom the earth shook off, having injured the progeny of the Brahmans, perished irretrievably.

verses.sa:
देवपीयुश्चरति मर्त्येषु गरगीर्णो भवत्यस्थिभूयान् ।
यो ब्राह्मणं देवबन्धुं हिनस्ति न स पितृयाणमप्येति लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
devapiyushcharati martyeshu garagirno bhavatyasthibhuyan |
yo brahmanam devabandhum hinasti na sa pitriyanamapyeti lokam ||
verses.en: The insulter of the gods goes about among mortals; he becomes one who has swallowed poison, [becomes] mainly composed of bones; he who injures the Brahman, the connection of the gods, he goes not to the world to which the Fathers go.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्वै नः पदवायः सोमो दायाद उच्यते ।
हन्ताभिशस्तेन्द्रस्तथा तद्वेधसो विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirvai nah padavayah somo dayada uchyate |
hantabhishastendrastatha tadvedhaso viduh ||
verses.en: Agni verily our guide. Soma is called [our] heir, Indra slayer of imprecation (?): so know the devout that.

verses.sa:
इषुरिव दिग्धा नृपते पृदाकूरिव गोपते ।
सा ब्राह्मणस्येषुर्घोरा तया विध्यति पीयतः ॥
verses.rom:
ishuriva digdha nripate pridakuriva gopate |
sa brahmanasyeshurghora taya vidhyati piyatah ||
verses.en: Like an arrow smeared [with poison], O lord of men, like an adder, O lord of cattle—that arrow of the Brahman is terrible; with it he pierces the insulting.

verses.sa:
अतिमात्रमवर्धन्त नोदिव दिवमस्पृशन् ।
भृगुं हिंसित्वा सृञ्जया वैतहव्याः पराभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
atimatramavardhanta nodiva divamasprishan |
bhrigum himsitva srinjaya vaitahavyah parabhavan ||
verses.en: They grew excessively; they did not quite (iva) touch up to the sky; having injured Bhrigu, the Sriñjayas, Vāitahavyas, perished.

verses.sa:
ये बृहत्सामानमाङ्गिरसमार्पयन् ब्राह्मणं जनाः ।
पेत्वस्तेषामुभयादमविस्तोकान्यावयत् ॥
verses.rom:
ye brihatsamanamangirasamarpayan brahmanam janah |
petvasteshamubhayadamavistokanyavayat ||
verses.en: The people who delivered up (? arpay-) the Brahman Brihatsāman, descendant of An̄giras—a he-goat with two rows of teeth, a sheep, consumed (av) their offspring (toká).

verses.sa:
ये ब्राह्मणं प्रत्यष्ठीवन् ये वास्मिञ्छुल्कमीषिरे ।
अस्नस्ते मध्ये कुल्यायाः केशान् खादन्त आसते ॥
verses.rom:
ye brahmanam pratyashthivan ye vasminchhulkamishire |
asnaste madhye kulyayah keshan khadanta asate ||
verses.en: They who spat upon a Brahman, or who sent [their] mucus at him—they sit in the midst of a stream of blood, devouring hair.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मगवी पच्यमाना यावत्साभि विजङ्गहे ।
तेजो राष्ट्रस्य निर्हन्ति न वीरो जायते वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
brahmagavi pachyamana yavatsabhi vijangahe |
tejo rashtrasya nirhanti na viro jayate vrisha ||
verses.en: The Brahman's cow, being cooked, as far as she penetrates (?), smites out the brightness (téjas) of a kingdom; no virile (vṛ́ṣan) hero is born [there].

verses.sa:
क्रूरमस्या आशसनं तृष्टं पिशितमस्यते ।
क्षीरं यदस्याः पीयते तद्वै पितृषु किल्बिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
kruramasya ashasanam trishtam pishitamasyate |
kshiram yadasyah piyate tadvai pitrishu kilbisham ||
verses.en: Cruel is the cutting up of her; harsh to eat (?) is her prepared flesh (piçitám); in that the milk (kṣīrá) of her is drunk, that verily is an offense against the Fathers.

verses.sa:
उग्रो राजा मन्यमानो ब्राह्मणं यो जिघत्सति ।
परा तत्सिच्यते राष्ट्रं ब्राह्मणो यत्र जीयते ॥
verses.rom:
ugro raja manyamano brahmanam yo jighatsati |
para tatsichyate rashtram brahmano yatra jiyate ||
verses.en: A king who thinks himself formidable, [and] who desires to devour a Brahman—that kingdom is poured away, where a Brahman is scathed (jyā).

verses.sa:
अष्टापदी चतुरक्षी चतुःश्रोत्रा चतुर्हनुः ।
द्व्यास्या द्विजिह्वा भूत्वा सा राष्ट्रमव धूनुते ब्रह्मज्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
ashtapadi chaturakshi chatuhshrotra chaturhanuh |
dvyasya dvijihva bhutva sa rashtramava dhunute brahmajyasya ||
verses.en: Becoming eight-footed, four-eyed, four-eared, four-jawed, two-mouthed, two-tongued, she shakes down the kingdom of the Brahman-scather.

verses.sa:
तद्वै राष्ट्रमा स्रवति नावं भिन्नामिवोदकम् ।
ब्रह्माणं यत्र हिंसन्ति तद्राष्ट्रं हन्ति दुछुना ॥
verses.rom:
tadvai rashtrama sravati navam bhinnamivodakam |
brahmanam yatra himsanti tadrashtram hanti duchhuna ||
verses.en: It leaks verily into that kingdom, as water into a split boat (nāú); where they injure a Brahman, that kingdom misfortune smites.

verses.sa:
तं वृक्षा अप सेधन्ति छायां नो मोप गा इति ।
यो ब्राह्मणस्य सद्धनमभि नारद मन्यते ॥
verses.rom:
tam vriksha apa sedhanti chhayam no mopa ga iti |
yo brahmanasya saddhanamabhi narada manyate ||
verses.en: Him the trees drive away, saying "do not come unto our shadow," who, O Nārada, plots against that which is the riches of the Brahman.

verses.sa:
विषमेतद्देवकृतं राजा वरुणोऽब्रवीत्।
न ब्राह्मणस्य गां जग्ध्वा रास्त्रे जागार कश्चन ॥
verses.rom:
vishametaddevakritam raja varuno'bravit|
na brahmanasya gam jagdhva rastre jagara kashchana ||
verses.en: King Varuṇa called that a god-made poison; no one soever, having devoured the cow of the Brahman, keeps watch in the kingdom.

verses.sa:
नवैव ता नवतयो या भूमिर्व्यधूनुत ।
प्रजां हिंसित्वा ब्राह्मणीमसंभव्यं पराभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
navaiva ta navatayo ya bhumirvyadhunuta |
prajam himsitva brahmanimasambhavyam parabhavan ||
verses.en: Those same nine nineties whom the earth shook off, having injured the progeny of the Brahman, perished irretrievably.

verses.sa:
यां मृतायानुबध्नन्ति कूद्यं पदयोपनीम् ।
तद्वै ब्रह्मज्य ते देवा उपस्तरणमब्रुवन् ॥
verses.rom:
yam mritayanubadhnanti kudyam padayopanim |
tadvai brahmajya te deva upastaranamabruvan ||
verses.en: The kūdī́ which they tie on after a dead man, as effacer (?) of the track, that verily, O Brahman-scather, did the gods call thy couch (upastáraṇa).

verses.sa:
अश्रूणि कृपमानस्य यानि जीतस्य वावृतुः ।
तं वै ब्रह्मज्य ते देवा अपां भागमधारयन् ॥
verses.rom:
ashruni kripamanasya yani jitasya vavrituh |
tam vai brahmajya te deva apam bhagamadharayan ||
verses.en: The tears of one weeping (kṛp), which rolled [down] when he was scathed, these verily, O Brahman-scather, did the gods maintain as thy portion of water.

verses.sa:
येन मृतं स्नपयन्ति श्मश्रूणि येनोन्दते ।
तं वै ब्रह्मज्य ते देवा अपां भागमधारयन् ॥
verses.rom:
yena mritam snapayanti shmashruni yenondate |
tam vai brahmajya te deva apam bhagamadharayan ||
verses.en: With what they bathe a dead man, with what they wet (ud) beards, that verily, O Brahman-scather, did the gods maintain as thy portion of water.

verses.sa:
न वर्षं मैत्रावरुणं ब्रह्मज्यमभि वर्षति ।
नास्मै समितिः कल्पते न मित्रं नयते वशम् ॥
verses.rom:
na varsham maitravarunam brahmajyamabhi varshati |
nasmai samitih kalpate na mitram nayate vasham ||
verses.en: The rain of Mitra-and- Varuna does not rain upon the Brahman-scather; the assembly (sámiti) does not suit (kḷp) him; he wins (nī) no friend to his control.

verses.sa:
उच्चैर्घोषो दुन्दुभिः सत्वनायन् वानस्पत्यः संभृत उस्रियाभिः ।
वाचं क्षुणुवानो दमयन्त्सपत्नान्त्सिंह इव जेष्यन्न् अभि तंस्तनीहि ॥
verses.rom:
uchchairghosho dundubhih satvanayan vanaspatyah sambhrita usriyabhih |
vacham kshunuvano damayantsapatnantsimha iva jeshyann abhi tamstanihi ||
verses.en: The loud-noised drum, warrior-like, of forest-tree, brought together (sámbhṛta) with the ruddy [kine], whetting the voice, dominating our rivals; thunder thou loudly against [them] like a lion, about to conquer.

verses.sa:
सिंह इवास्तानीद्द्रुवयो विबद्धोऽभिक्रन्दन्न् ऋषभो वासितामिव ।
वृषा त्वं वध्रयस्ते सपत्ना ऐन्द्रस्ते शुष्मो अभिमातिषाहः ॥
verses.rom:
simha ivastaniddruvayo vibaddho'bhikrandann rishabho vasitamiva |
vrisha tvam vadhrayaste sapatna aindraste shushmo abhimatishahah ||
verses.en: Like a lion hath thundered the wooden one, stretched (vi-bandh), like a bull roaring at a longing cow; virile (vṛ́ṣan) [art] thou, impotent thy rivals; Indra-like [is] thy vehemence (çúṣma), overpowering hostile plotters.

verses.sa:
वृषेव यूथे सहसा विदानो गव्यन्न् अभि रुव संधनाजित्।
शुचा विध्य हृदयं परेषां हित्वा ग्रामान् प्रच्युता यन्तु शत्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisheva yuthe sahasa vidano gavyann abhi ruva samdhanajit|
