shucha vidhya hridayam paresham hitva graman prachyuta yantu shatravah ||
verses.en: Found (vidāná) suddenly (sáhasā) like a bull in a herd, do thou, seeking kine, bellow (ru) at [them], winning booty; pierce thou with pain the heart of our adversaries; let our foes, leaving their villages, go urged forth (pra-cyu).

verses.sa:
संजयन् पृतना ऊर्ध्वमायुर्गृह्या गृह्णानो बहुधा वि चक्ष्व ।
दैवीं वाचं दुन्दुभ आ गुरस्व वेधाः शत्रूणामुप भरस्व वेदः ॥
verses.rom:
samjayan pritana urdhvamayurgrihya grihnano bahudha vi chakshva |
daivim vacham dundubha a gurasva vedhah shatrunamupa bharasva vedah ||
verses.en: Wholly conquering the fighters, shrill-crying, do thou, seizing those that are to be seized, look abroad on many sides; respond (? ā-gur), O drum, devout, to the voice of the gods; bring the possession of our foes.

verses.sa:
दुन्दुभेर्वाचं प्रयतां वदन्तीमाशृण्वती नाथिता घोषबुद्धा ।
नारी पुत्रं धावतु हस्तगृह्यामित्री भीता समरे वधानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
dundubhervacham prayatam vadantimashrinvati nathita ghoshabuddha |
nari putram dhavatu hastagrihyamitri bhita samare vadhanam ||
verses.en: Hearing the uttered (pra-yam) voice of the drum speaking, let the woman, suppliant, noise-wakened, run to her son, seizing his hand—our enemy, frightened in the conflict of deadly weapons.

verses.sa:
पूर्वो दुन्दुभे प्र वदासि वाचं भूम्याः पृष्ठे वद रोचमानः ।
अमित्रसेनामभिजञ्जभानो द्युमद्वद दुन्दुभे सूनृतावत् ॥
verses.rom:
purvo dundubhe pra vadasi vacham bhumyah prishthe vada rochamanah |
amitrasenamabhijanjabhano dyumadvada dundubhe sunritavat ||
verses.en: Mayest thou first (pū́rva), O drum, speak forth thy voice; on the back of earth speak thou, shining (ruc); opening wide the jaws (jabh) on the army of our enemies, speak thou clearly, O drum, pleasantly (sūnṛ́tāvat).

verses.sa:
अन्तरेमे नभसी घोषो अस्तु पृथक्ते ध्वनयो यन्तु शीभम् ।
अभि क्रन्द स्तनयोत्पिपानः श्लोककृन् मित्रतूर्याय स्वर्धी ॥
verses.rom:
antareme nabhasi ghosho astu prithakte dhvanayo yantu shibham |
abhi kranda stanayotpipanah shlokakrin mitraturyaya svardhi ||
verses.en: Let there be noise between these two firmaments (nábhas); severally let thy sounds (dhvaní) go swiftly; roar at [them], thunder, truculent (?), resounding (çlokakṛ́t) unto the victory of our friends, a good partizan.

verses.sa:
धीभिः कृतः प्र वदाति वाचमुद्धर्षय सत्वनामायुधानि ।
इन्द्रमेदी सत्वनो नि ह्वयस्व मित्रैरमित्राँ अव जङ्घनीहि ॥
verses.rom:
dhibhih kritah pra vadati vachamuddharshaya satvanamayudhani |
indramedi satvano ni hvayasva mitrairamitran ava janghanihi ||
verses.en: Made by devices (dhī́), may it speak forth its voice; excite thou the weapons of the warriors; allied with Indra, call in the warriors; by friends smite mightily down the enemies.

verses.sa:
संक्रन्दनः प्रवदो धृष्णुषेणः प्रवेदकृद् बहुधा ग्रामघोषी ।
श्रेयो वन्वानो वयुनानि विद्वान् कीर्तिं बहुभ्यो वि हर द्विराजे ॥
verses.rom:
samkrandanah pravado dhrishnushenah pravedakrid bahudha gramaghoshi |
shreyo vanvano vayunani vidvan kirtim bahubhyo vi hara dviraje ||
verses.en: A vociferating herald (? pravadá), with bold army, making proclaim in many places, sounding through the villages, winning advantage, knowing the ways, do thou distribute (vi-hṛ) fame to many in the [battle] of two kings.

verses.sa:
श्रेयःकेतो वसुजित्सहीयान्त्संग्रामजित्संशितो ब्रह्मणासि ।
अंशून् इव ग्रावाधिषवणे अद्रिर्गव्यन् दुन्दुभेऽधि नृत्य वेदः ॥
verses.rom:
shreyahketo vasujitsahiyantsamgramajitsamshito brahmanasi |
amshun iva gravadhishavane adrirgavyan dundubhe'dhi nritya vedah ||
verses.en: Aiming at advantage, conquering good things, very powerful, conquering a host, thou art sharpened by bráhman; as the pressing-stone on the [soma-] stalks in the press, do thou, O drum, dance on [their] possession, seeking booty (gavyán).

verses.sa:
शत्रूषाण्नीषादभिमातिषाहो गवेषणः सहमान उद्भित्।
वाग्वीव मन्त्रं प्र भरस्व वाचं सांग्रामजित्यायेषमुद्वदेह ॥
verses.rom:
shatrushannishadabhimatishaho gaveshanah sahamana udbhit|
vagviva mantram pra bharasva vacham samgramajityayeshamudvadeha ||
verses.en: Overpowering foes, overpowering and putting down, overpowering hostile plotters, seeking kine, overpowering, up-shooting, bring forth thy voice as a speaker (vāgvín) his discourse (mántra); speak up force (? íṣ) here in order to the conquering of the host.

verses.sa:
अच्युतच्युत्समदो गमिष्ठो मृधो जेता पुरएतायोध्यः ।
इन्द्रेण गुप्तो विदथा निचिक्यद्धृद्द्योतनो द्विषतां याहि शीभम् ॥
verses.rom:
achyutachyutsamado gamishtho mridho jeta puraetayodhyah |
indrena gupto vidatha nichikyaddhriddyotano dvishatam yahi shibham ||
verses.en: Stirring (cyu) the unstirred, going oftenest into contests, conquering scorners, going in front, unsubduable, made safe by Indra, noting counsels (? vidátha), burning the hearts of our adversaries, go thou quickly.

verses.sa:
विहृदयं वैमनस्यं वदामित्रेषु दुन्दुभे ।
विद्वेषं कश्मशं भयममित्रेषु नि दध्मस्यव एनान् दुन्दुभे जहि ॥
verses.rom:
vihridayam vaimanasyam vadamitreshu dundubhe |
vidvesham kashmasham bhayamamitreshu ni dadhmasyava enan dundubhe jahi ||
verses.en: Division of hearts, division of minds speak thou among our enemies, O drum; mutual hate, confusion, fear, we put into our enemies: smite them down, O drum.

verses.sa:
उद्वेपमाना मनसा चक्षुषा हृदयेन च ।
धावन्तु बिभ्यतोऽमित्राः प्रत्रासेनाज्ये हुते ॥
verses.rom:
udvepamana manasa chakshusha hridayena cha |
dhavantu bibhyato'mitrah pratrasenajye hute ||
verses.en: Quaking with mind, with sight, and with heart, let our enemies run fearing with alarm (pratrāsá) when the sacrificial butter is offered.

verses.sa:
वानस्पत्यः संभृत उस्रियाभिर्विश्वगोत्र्यः ।
प्रत्रासममित्रेभ्यो वदाज्येनाभिघारितः ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspatyah sambhrita usriyabhirvishvagotryah |
pratrasamamitrebhyo vadajyenabhigharitah ||
verses.en: Made of forest-tree, brought together with the ruddy [kine], belonging to all the families (-gotrá-), speak thou alarm for our enemies, being smeared with sacrificial butter.

verses.sa:
यथा मृगाः संविजन्त आरण्याः पुरुषादधि ।
एव त्वं दुन्दुभेऽमित्रान् अभि क्रन्द प्र त्रासयाथो चित्तानि मोहय ॥
verses.rom:
yatha mrigah samvijanta aranyah purushadadhi |
eva tvam dundubhe'mitran abhi kranda pra trasayatho chittani mohaya ||
verses.en: As the wild beasts of the forest are all in a tremble at man, so do thou, O drum, roar at [and] alarm our enemies, then confound their intents.

verses.sa:
यथा वृकादजावयो धावन्ति बहु बिभ्यतीः ।
एव त्वं दुन्दुभेऽमित्रान् अभि क्रन्द प्र त्रासयाथो चित्तानि मोहय ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vrikadajavayo dhavanti bahu bibhyatih |
eva tvam dundubhe'mitran abhi kranda pra trasayatho chittani mohaya ||
verses.en: As the goats-and-sheep run greatly fearing the wolf, so do thou, O drum etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा श्येनात्पतत्रिणः संविजन्ते अहर्दिवि सिंहस्य स्तनथोर्यथा ।
एव त्वं दुन्दुभेऽमित्रान् अभि क्रन्द प्र त्रासयाथो चित्तानि मोहय ॥
verses.rom:
yatha shyenatpatatrinah samvijante ahardivi simhasya stanathoryatha |
eva tvam dundubhe'mitran abhi kranda pra trasayatho chittani mohaya ||
verses.en: As the birds (patatrín) are all in a tremble at the falcon, day by day; as at the thundering of the lion, so do thou, O drum etc. etc.

verses.sa:
परामित्रान् दुन्दुभिना हरिणस्याजिनेन च ।
सर्वे देवा अतित्रसन् ये संग्रामस्येषते ॥
verses.rom:
paramitran dundubhina harinasyajinena cha |
sarve deva atitrasan ye samgramasyeshate ||
verses.en: Away have all the gods alarmed our enemies by the drum and the skin of the gazelle—[the gods] who are masters of the host.

verses.sa:
यैरिन्द्रः प्रक्रीडते पद्घोषैश्छायया सह ।
तैरमित्रास्त्रसन्तु नोऽमी ये यन्त्यनीकशः ॥
verses.rom:
yairindrah prakridate padghoshaishchhayaya saha |
tairamitrastrasantu no'mi ye yantyanikashah ||
verses.en: With what foot-noises Indra plays together with shadow, by those let our enemies be alarmed who go yonder in troops (anīkaçás).

verses.sa:
ज्याघोषा दुन्दुभयोऽभि क्रोशन्तु या दिशः ।
सेनाः पराजिता यतीरमित्राणामनीकशः ॥
verses.rom:
jyaghosha dundubhayo'bhi kroshantu ya dishah |
senah parajita yatiramitranamanikashah ||
verses.en: Let the drums, with bow-string noises, yell toward all (yā́s) the quarters—the armies of our enemies going conquered in troops.

verses.sa:
आदित्य चक्षुरा दत्स्व मरीचयोऽनु धावत ।
पत्सङ्गिनीरा सजन्तु विगते बाहुवीर्ये ॥
verses.rom:
aditya chakshura datsva marichayo'nu dhavata |
patsanginira sajantu vigate bahuvirye ||
verses.en: O Āditya, take [away their] sight; ye beams, run after; let them that have foot-fastenings fasten on, the arm-power (-vīryà) being gone away.

verses.sa:
यूयमुग्रा मरुतः पृश्निमातर इन्द्रेण युजा प्र मृनीत शत्रून् ।
सोमो राजा वरुणो राजा महादेव उत मृत्युरिन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
yuyamugra marutah prishnimatara indrena yuja pra mrinita shatrun |
somo raja varuno raja mahadeva uta mrityurindrah ||
verses.en: Do ye [who are] formidable, O Maruts, sons of the spotted mother, with Indra as ally, slaughter our foes.

verses.sa:
एता देवसेनाः सूर्यकेतवः सचेतसः ।
अमित्रान् नो जयन्तु स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
eta devasenah suryaketavah sachetasah |
amitran no jayantu svaha ||
verses.en: Let these armies of the gods, sun-bannered, accordant, conquer our enemies: hail!

verses.sa:
अग्निस्तक्मानमप बाधतामितः सोमो ग्रावा वरुणः पूतदक्षाः ।
वेदिर्बर्हिः समिधः शोशुचाना अप द्वेषांस्यमुया भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
agnistakmanamapa badhatamitah somo grava varunah putadakshah |
vedirbarhih samidhah shoshuchana apa dveshamsyamuya bhavantu ||
verses.en: Let Agni drive (bādh) the fever away from here; [let] Soma, the pressing-stone, Varuṇa of purified dexterity, the sacrificial hearth, the barhís, the brightly gleaming (çuc) fuel; be hatreds away yonder.

verses.sa:
अयं यो विश्वान् हरितान् कृणोष्युच्छोचयन्न् अग्निरिवाभिदुन्वन् ।
अधा हि तक्मन्न् अरसो हि भूया अधा न्यङ्ङधरान् वा परेहि ॥
verses.rom:
ayam yo vishvan haritan krinoshyuchchhochayann agnirivabhidunvan |
adha hi takmann araso hi bhuya adha nyannadharan va parehi ||
verses.en: Thou here that makest all [men] yellow, heating (çuc) up like fire, consuming; now then, O fever—for mayest thou become sapless—now go away inward or downward.

verses.sa:
यः परुषः पारुषेयोऽवध्वंस इवारुणः ।
तक्मानं विश्वधावीर्याधराञ्चं परा सुवा ॥
verses.rom:
yah parushah parusheyo'vadhvamsa ivarunah |
takmanam vishvadhaviryadharancham para suva ||
verses.en: The fever that is spotted, speckled, ruddy like a sprinkling, do thou, O thou of power (-vīryà) in every direction, impel away downward.

verses.sa:
अधराञ्चं प्र हिणोमि नमः कृत्वा तक्मने ।
शकम्भरस्य मुष्टिहा पुनरेतु महावृषान् ॥
verses.rom:
adharancham pra hinomi namah kritva takmane |
shakambharasya mushtiha punaretu mahavrishan ||
verses.en: I send [him] forth downward, having paid homage to the fever; let the fist-slayer of the dung-bearer (?) go back to the Mahāvrishas.

verses.sa:
ओको अस्य मूजवन्त ओको अस्य महावृषाः ।
यावज्जातस्तक्मंस्तावान् असि बल्हिकेषु न्योचरः ॥
verses.rom:
oko asya mujavanta oko asya mahavrishah |
yavajjatastakmamstavan asi balhikeshu nyocharah ||
verses.en: Its home (ókas) is the Mūjavants, its home is the Mahāvrishas; as long as born, O fever, so long art thou at home among the Balhikas.

verses.sa:
तक्मन् व्याल वि गद व्यङ्ग भूरि यावय ।
दासीं निष्टक्वरीमिच्छ तां वज्रेण समर्पय ॥
verses.rom:
takman vyala vi gada vyanga bhuri yavaya |
dasim nishtakvarimichchha tam vajrena samarpaya ||
verses.en: O fever, trickish one, speak out (?); O limbless one, keep much away (?); seek the fugitive (?) barbarian woman; make her meet a thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
तक्मन् मूजवतो गच्छ बल्हिकान् वा परस्तराम् ।
शूद्रामिच्छ प्रफर्व्यं तां तक्मन् वीव धूनुहि ॥
verses.rom:
takman mujavato gachchha balhikan va parastaram |
shudramichchha prapharvyam tam takman viva dhunuhi ||
verses.en: O fever, go to the Mūjavants, or to the Balhikas, further off; seek the wanton Çūdra woman; her, O fever, do thou shake up a bit (iva).

verses.sa:
महावृषान् मूजवतो बन्ध्वद्धि परेत्य ।
प्रैतानि तक्मने ब्रूमो अन्यक्षेत्राणि वा इमा ॥
verses.rom:
mahavrishan mujavato bandhvaddhi paretya |
praitani takmane brumo anyakshetrani va ima ||
verses.en: Going away, eat thou thy connection (bándhu), the Mahāvrishas [and] Mūjavants; those [fields] we announce to the fever; others' fields verily [are] these.

verses.sa:
अन्यक्षेत्रे न रमसे वशी सन् मृडयासि नः ।
अभूदु प्रार्थस्तक्मा स गमिष्यति बल्हिकान् ॥
verses.rom:
anyakshetre na ramase vashi san mridayasi nah |
abhudu prarthastakma sa gamishyati balhikan ||
verses.en: In another's field thou restest (ram) not; being in control, mayest thou be gracious to us; the fever hath become ready (?); it will go to the Balhikas.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वं शीतोऽथो रूरः सह कासावेपयः ।
भीमास्ते तक्मन् हेतयस्ताभिः स्म परि वृङ्ग्धि नः ॥
verses.rom:
yattvam shito'tho rurah saha kasavepayah |
bhimaste takman hetayastabhih sma pari vringdhi nah ||
verses.en: In that thou, being cold, then hot (rūrá), didst cause trembling, together with cough—fearful are thy missiles, O fever; with them do thou avoid us.

verses.sa:
मा स्मैतान्त्सखीन् कुरुथा बलासं कासमुद्युगम् ।
मा स्मातोऽर्वाङैः पुनस्तत्त्वा तक्मन्न् उप ब्रुवे ॥
verses.rom:
ma smaitantsakhin kurutha balasam kasamudyugam |
ma smato'rvanaih punastattva takmann upa bruve ||
verses.en: Do not thou make them thy companions—the balā́sa, the cough, the udyugá (?); come not back hitherward from there: for that, O fever, I appeal to thee.

verses.sa:
तक्मन् भ्रात्रा बलासेन स्वस्रा कासिकया सह ।
पाप्मा भ्रातृव्येण सह गछामुमरणं जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
takman bhratra balasena svasra kasikaya saha |
papma bhratrivyena saha gachhamumaranam janam ||
verses.en: O fever, together with thy brother the balā́sa [and] thy sister the cough, together with thy cousin the scab (pāmán), go to yon foreign people.

verses.sa:
तृतीयकं वितृतीयं सदन्दिमुत शारदम् ।
तक्मानं शीतं रूरं ग्रैष्मं नाशय वार्षिकम् ॥
verses.rom:
tritiyakam vitritiyam sadandimuta sharadam |
takmanam shitam ruram graishmam nashaya varshikam ||
verses.en: The fever of the third day, of two days out of three, the constant, and the autumnal, the cold, the hot, that of the hot season, that of the rainy season, do thou cause to disappear.

verses.sa:
गन्धारिभ्यो मूजवद्भ्योऽङ्गेभ्यो मगधेभ्यः ।
प्रैष्यन् जनमिव शेवधिं तक्मानं परि दद्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
gandharibhyo mujavadbhyo'ngebhyo magadhebhyah |
praishyan janamiva shevadhim takmanam pari dadmasi ||
verses.en: To the Gandhāris, the Mūjavants, the An̄gas, the Magadhas, like one sending a person a treasure, do we commit the fever.

verses.sa:
ओते मे द्यावापृथिवी ओता देवी सरस्वती ।
ओतौ म इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च क्रिमिं जम्भयतामिति ॥
verses.rom:
ote me dyavaprithivi ota devi sarasvati |
otau ma indrashchagnishcha krimim jambhayatamiti ||
verses.en: Worked in (óta) for me [are] heaven-and-earth; worked in [is] divine Sarasvatī; worked in for me [are] both Indra and Agni: to the effect "let them (dual) grind up the worm."

verses.sa:
अस्येन्द्र कुमारस्य क्रिमीन् धनपते जहि ।
हता विश्वा अरातय उग्रेण वचसा मम ॥
verses.rom:
asyendra kumarasya krimin dhanapate jahi |
hata vishva arataya ugrena vachasa mama ||
verses.en: O Indra, lord of riches, smite thou the worms of this boy; smitten are all the niggards by my formidable spell (vácas).

verses.sa:
यो अक्ष्यौ परिसर्पति यो नासे परिसर्पति ।
दतां यो मध्यं गच्छति तं क्रिमिं जम्भयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yo akshyau parisarpati yo nase parisarpati |
datam yo madhyam gachchhati tam krimim jambhayamasi ||
verses.en: What one creeps about his eyes, what one creeps about his nostrils, what one goes to the midst of his teeth—that worm do we grind up.

verses.sa:
सरूपौ द्वौ विरूपौ द्वौ कृष्णौ द्वौ रोहितौ द्वौ ।
बभ्रुश्च बभ्रुकर्णश्च गृध्रः कोकश्च ते हताः ॥
verses.rom:
sarupau dvau virupau dvau krishnau dvau rohitau dvau |
babhrushcha babhrukarnashcha gridhrah kokashcha te hatah ||
verses.en: Of like form two, of various form two, black two, red two; both the brown and the brown-eared, the vulture and the cuckoo (kóka)—they are slain.

verses.sa:
ये क्रिमयः शितिकक्षा ये कृष्णाः शितिबाहवः ।
ये के च विश्वरूपास्तान् क्रिमीन् जम्भयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
ye krimayah shitikaksha ye krishnah shitibahavah |
ye ke cha vishvarupastan krimin jambhayamasi ||
verses.en: The worms that are white-sided, that are black with white arms, and whatever ones are of all forms—those worms we grind up.

verses.sa:
उत्पुरस्तात्सूर्य एति विश्वदृष्टो अदृष्टहा ।
दृष्टांश्च घ्नन्न् अदृष्टांश्च सर्वांश्च प्रमृणन् क्रिमीन् ॥
verses.rom:
utpurastatsurya eti vishvadrishto adrishtaha |
drishtamshcha ghnann adrishtamshcha sarvamshcha pramrinan krimin ||
verses.en: Up in the east goes the sun, seen of all, slayer of the unseen, slaying both those seen and those unseen, and slaughtering all worms.

verses.sa:
येवाषासः कष्कषास एजत्काः शिपवित्नुकाः ।
दृष्टश्च हन्यतां क्रिमिरुतादृष्टश्च हन्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yevashasah kashkashasa ejatkah shipavitnukah |
drishtashcha hanyatam krimirutadrishtashcha hanyatam ||
verses.en: The yévāshas, the káshkashas, the stirrers, the çipavitnukás—both let the seen worm be slain, and let the unseen be slain.

verses.sa:
हतो येवाषः क्रिमीणां हतो नदनिमोत ।
सर्वान् नि मष्मषाकरं दृषदा खल्वामिव ॥
verses.rom:
hato yevashah kriminam hato nadanimota |
sarvan ni mashmashakaram drishada khalvamiva ||
verses.en: Slain is the yévāsha of the worms, slain also the nadanimán; I have put them all down, smash (? maṣmaṣā́) like khálva-grains with a millstone.

verses.sa:
त्रिशीर्षाणं त्रिककुदं क्रिमिं सारङ्गमर्जुनम् ।
शृणाम्यस्य पृष्टीरपि वृश्चामि यच्छिरः ॥
verses.rom:
trishirshanam trikakudam krimim sarangamarjunam |
shrinamyasya prishtirapi vrishchami yachchhirah ||
verses.en: The three-headed, the three-humped (-kakúd), the variegated, the whitish worm—I crush the ribs of it; I hew at what is its head.

verses.sa:
अत्रिवद्वः क्रिमयो हन्मि कण्ववज्जमदग्निवत्।
अगस्त्यस्य ब्रह्मणा सं पिनष्म्यहं क्रिमीन् ॥
verses.rom:
atrivadvah krimayo hanmi kanvavajjamadagnivat|
agastyasya brahmana sam pinashmyaham krimin ||
verses.en: Like Atri I slay you, O worms, like Kaṇva, like Jamadagni; with the incantation of Agastya I mash together the worms.

verses.sa:
हतो राजा क्रिमीणामुतैषां स्थपतिर्हतः ।
हतो हतमाता क्रिमिर्हतभ्राता हतस्वसा ॥
verses.rom:
hato raja kriminamutaisham sthapatirhatah |
hato hatamata krimirhatabhrata hatasvasa ||
verses.en: Slain is the king of the worms, also the chief of them is slain; slain is the worm, having its mother slain, its brother slain, its sister slain.

verses.sa:
हतासो अस्य वेशसो हतासः परिवेशसः ।
अथो ये क्षुल्लका इव सर्वे ते क्रिमयो हताः ॥
verses.rom:
hataso asya veshaso hatasah pariveshasah |
atho ye kshullaka iva sarve te krimayo hatah ||
verses.en: Slain are its neighbors, slain its further neighbors, also those that are petty, as it were—all those worms are slain.

verses.sa:
सर्वेषां च क्रिमीणां सर्वासां च क्रिमीनाम् ।
भिनद्म्यश्मना शिरो दहाम्यग्निना मुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarvesham cha kriminam sarvasam cha kriminam |
bhinadmyashmana shiro dahamyagnina mukham ||
verses.en: Both of all worms and of all she-worms I split the head with a stone, I burn the mouth with fire.

verses.sa:
सविता प्रसवानामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
savita prasavanamadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: Savitar ('the impeller') is overlord of impulses; let him favor (av) me, in this worship (bráhman), in this rite (kárman), in this representation

verses.sa:
अग्निर्वनस्पतीनामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
agnirvanaspatinamadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: Agni is overlord of forest-trees; let him favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
द्यावापृथिवी दातॄणामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
dyavaprithivi datrinamadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: Heaven-and-earth are overlords of givers; let them favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
वरुणोऽपामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
varuno'pamadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: Varuṇa is overlord of the waters; let him favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
मित्रावरुणौ वृष्ट्याधिपती तौ मावताम् ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
mitravarunau vrishtyadhipati tau mavatam |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: Mitra-and-Varuṇa are overlords of rain; let them favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
मरुतः पर्वतानामधिपतयस्ते मावन्तु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
marutah parvatanamadhipatayaste mavantu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: The Maruts are overlords of the mountains; let them favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सोमो वीरुधामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
somo virudhamadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: Soma is overlord of plants; let him favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
वायुरन्तरिक्षस्याधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
vayurantarikshasyadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: Vāyu is overlord of the atmosphere; let him favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सूर्यश्चक्षुषामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
suryashchakshushamadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: The sun (sū́rya) is overlord of sights (or eyes: cákṣus); let him favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा नक्षत्राणामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
chandrama nakshatranamadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: The moon is overlord of asterisms; let him favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दिवोऽधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
indro divo'dhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: Indra is overlord of heaven; let him favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
मरुतां पिता पशूनामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
marutam pita pashunamadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: The father of the Maruts is overlord of cattle; let him favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
मृत्युः प्रजानामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
mrityuh prajanamadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: Death is overlord of creatures (prajā́); let him favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमः पितॄणामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
yamah pitrinamadhipatih sa mavatu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: Yama is overlord of the Fathers; let him etc. etc.

verses.sa:
पितरः परे ते मावन्तु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
pitarah pare te mavantu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: The upper (pára) Fathers—let them favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
तता अवरे ते मावन्तु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
tata avare te mavantu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: The lower (ávara) Fathers (tatá)—let them favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततस्ततामहास्ते मावन्तु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्याम् चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
tatastatamahaste mavantu |
asmin brahmanyasmin karmanyasyam purodhayamasyam pratishthayamasyam chittyamasyamakutyamasyamashishyasyam devahutyam svaha ||
verses.en: The Fathers (tatá), the grandfathers (tatāmahá)—let them favor etc. etc.

verses.sa:
पर्वताद्दिवो योनेरङ्गादङ्गात्समाभृतम् ।
शेपो गर्भस्य रेतोधाः सरौ पर्णमिवा दधत् ॥
verses.rom:
parvataddivo yonerangadangatsamabhritam |
shepo garbhasya retodhah sarau parnamiva dadhat ||
verses.en: Brought together from the cloud (? párvata), from the womb (yóni) of the sky, from every member, let the virile organ, seed-placer of the embryo, set (ā-dhā) [it] like the feather on the shaft.

verses.sa:
यथेयं पृथिवी मही भूतानां गर्भमादधे ।
एवा दधामि ते गर्भं तस्मै त्वामवसे हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
yatheyam prithivi mahi bhutanam garbhamadadhe |
eva dadhami te garbham tasmai tvamavase huve ||
verses.en: As this great earth receives the embryo of existences, so do I set thine embryo; I call thee to its aid.

verses.sa:
गर्भं धेहि सिनीवालि गर्भं धेहि सरस्वति ।
गर्भं ते अश्विनोभा धत्तां पुष्करस्रजा ॥
verses.rom:
garbham dhehi sinivali garbham dhehi sarasvati |
garbham te ashvinobha dhattam pushkarasraja ||
verses.en: Place the embryo, O Sinīvālī; place the embryo, O Sarasvatī; let both the Açvins, garlanded with blue lotus, set thine embryo.

verses.sa:
गर्भं ते मित्रावरुणौ गर्भं देवो बृहस्पतिः ।
गर्भं त इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च गर्भं धाता दधातु ते ॥
verses.rom:
garbham te mitravarunau garbham devo brihaspatih |
garbham ta indrashchagnishcha garbham dhata dadhatu te ||
verses.en: Thine embryo let Mitra-and-Varuṇa, [thine] embryo let god Brihaspati, thine embryo let both Indra and Agni, thine embryo let Dhātar place.

verses.sa:
विष्णुर्योनिं कल्पयतु त्वष्टा रूपाणि पिंशतु ।
आ सिञ्चतु प्रजापतिर्धाता गर्भं दधातु ते ॥
verses.rom:
vishnuryonim kalpayatu tvashta rupani pimshatu |
a sinchatu prajapatirdhata garbham dadhatu te ||
verses.en: Let Vishṇu prepare the womb (yóni); let Tvashṭar adorn the forms; let Prajāpati pour on; let Dhātar place thine embryo.

verses.sa:
यद्वेद राजा वरुणो यद्वा देवी सरस्वती ।
यदिन्द्रो वृत्रहा वेद तद्गर्भकरणं पिब ॥
verses.rom:
yadveda raja varuno yadva devi sarasvati |
yadindro vritraha veda tadgarbhakaranam piba ||
verses.en: What king Varuṇa, or what divine Sarasvatī knows, what Indra the Vritra-slayer knows, that embryo-maker do thou drink.

verses.sa:
गर्भो अस्योषधीनां गर्भो वनस्पतीनाम् ।
गर्भो विश्वस्य भूतस्य सो अग्ने गर्भमेह धाः ॥
verses.rom:
garbho asyoshadhinam garbho vanaspatinam |
garbho vishvasya bhutasya so agne garbhameha dhah ||
verses.en: Embryo art thou of herbs, embryo of forest-trees, embryo of every existence; mayest thou, O Agni, set an embryo here.

verses.sa:
अधि स्कन्द वीरयस्व गर्भमा धेहि योन्याम् ।
वृषासि वृष्ण्यावन् प्रजायै त्वा नयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
adhi skanda virayasva garbhama dhehi yonyam |
vrishasi vrishnyavan prajayai tva nayamasi ||
verses.en: Mount thou; play the hero; set an embryo in the womb; virile (vṛ́ṣan) art thou, that hast virility; for progeny do we conduct thee hither.

verses.sa:
वि जिहीष्व बार्हत्सामे गर्भस्ते योनिमा शयाम् ।
अदुष्टे देवाः पुत्रं सोमपा उभयाविनम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi jihishva barhatsame garbhaste yonima shayam |
adushte devah putram somapa ubhayavinam ||
verses.en: Go apart, O Bārhatsāmā; let an embryo lie unto thy womb (yóni); the gods, soma-drinkers, have given thee a son partaking of both.

verses.sa:
धातः श्रेष्ठेन रूपेणास्या नार्या गवीन्योः ।
पुमांसं पुत्रमा धेहि दशमे मासि सूतवे ॥
verses.rom:
dhatah shreshthena rupenasya narya gavinyoh |
pumamsam putrama dhehi dashame masi sutave ||
verses.en: O Dhatar, with best form, in the two groins of this woman do thou set a male (púmāṅs) son, to be born in the tenth month.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टः श्रेष्ठेन रूपेणास्या नार्या गवीन्योः ।
पुमांसं पुत्रमा धेहि दशमे मासि सूतवे ॥
verses.rom:
tvashtah shreshthena rupenasya narya gavinyoh |
pumamsam putrama dhehi dashame masi sutave ||
verses.en: O Tvashṭar, with best etc. etc.

verses.sa:
सवितः श्रेष्ठेन रूपेणास्या नार्या गवीन्योः ।
पुमांसं पुत्रमा धेहि दशमे मासि सूतवे ॥
verses.rom:
savitah shreshthena rupenasya narya gavinyoh |
pumamsam putrama dhehi dashame masi sutave ||
verses.en: O Savitar ('impeller'), with best etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्रजापते श्रेष्ठेन रूपेणास्या नार्या गवीन्योः ।
पुमांसं पुत्रमा धेहि दशमे मासि सूतवे ॥
verses.rom:
prajapate shreshthena rupenasya narya gavinyoh |
pumamsam putrama dhehi dashame masi sutave ||
verses.en: O Prajāpati, with best etc. etc.

verses.sa: यजूंषि यज्ञे समिधः स्वाहाग्निः प्रविद्वान् इह वो युनक्तु ॥
verses.rom: yajumshi yajne samidhah svahagnih pravidvan iha vo yunaktu ||
verses.en: The sacrificial formulas (yájus) at the sacrifice, the fuel, hail! let Agni, foreknowing, here join for you.

verses.sa: युनक्तु देवः सविता प्रजानन्न् अस्मिन् यज्ञे महिषः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: yunaktu devah savita prajanann asmin yajne mahishah svaha ||
verses.en: Let the heavenly impeller (savitár), the bull (mahiṣá), foreknowing, join [them] at this sacrifice: hail!

verses.sa: इन्द्र उक्थामदान्यस्मिन् यज्ञे प्रविद्वान् युनक्तु सुयुजः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: indra ukthamadanyasmin yajne pravidvan yunaktu suyujah svaha ||
verses.en: Let Indra, foreknowing, at this sacrifice join songs and revels (ukthāmadá), the well-joined ones (?): hail!

verses.sa: प्रैषा यज्ञे निविदः स्वाहा शिष्टाः पत्नीभिर्वहतेह युक्ताः ॥
verses.rom: praisha yajne nividah svaha shishtah patnibhirvahateha yuktah ||
verses.en: The directions (prāiṣá) at the sacrifice, the notices (nivíd): hail! taught by the wives, carry ye here, joined.

verses.sa: छन्दांसि यज्ञे मरुतः स्वाहा मातेव पुत्रं पिपृतेह युक्ताः ॥
verses.rom: chhandamsi yajne marutah svaha mateva putram pipriteha yuktah ||
verses.en: The meters (chándas) at the sacrifice, O Maruts: hail! as a mother her son, fill ye here, joined.

verses.sa: एयमगन् बर्हिषा प्रोक्षणीभिर्यज्ञं तन्वानादितिः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: eyamagan barhisha prokshanibhiryajnam tanvanaditih svaha ||
verses.en: Here hath come Aditi, with barhís, with sprinkling [waters], extending the sacrifice: hail!

verses.sa: विष्णुर्युनक्तु बहुधा तपांस्यस्मिन् यज्ञे सुयुजः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: vishnuryunaktu bahudha tapamsyasmin yajne suyujah svaha ||
verses.en: Let Vishnu join variously the fervors (tápas) at this sacrifice, the well-joined ones: hail!

verses.sa: त्वष्टा युनक्तु बहुधा नु रूपा अस्मिन् यज्ञे युनक्तु सुयुजः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: tvashta yunaktu bahudha nu rupa asmin yajne yunaktu suyujah svaha ||
verses.en: Let Tvashtar now join variously the forms at this sacrifice, the well-joined ones: hail!

verses.sa: भगो युनक्त्वाशिषो न्वस्मा अस्मिन् यज्ञे प्रविद्वान् युनक्तु सुयुजः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: bhago yunaktvashisho nvasma asmin yajne pravidvan yunaktu suyujah svaha ||
verses.en: Let Bhaga join now for him the blessings (āçís); at this sacrifice let him, foreknowing, join the well-joined ones: hail!

verses.sa: सोमो युनक्तु बहुधा पयांस्यस्मिन् यज्ञे सुयुजः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: somo yunaktu bahudha payamsyasmin yajne suyujah svaha ||
verses.en: Let Soma join variously the milks (páyas), at this sacrifice, the well-joined ones: hail!

verses.sa: इन्द्रो युनक्तु बहुधा पयांस्यस्मिन् यज्ञे सुयुजः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: indro yunaktu bahudha payamsyasmin yajne suyujah svaha ||
verses.en: Let Indra join variously the heroisms, at this sacrifice, the well-joined ones: hail!

verses.sa:
अश्विना ब्रह्मणा यातमर्वाञ्चौ वषट्कारेण यज्ञं वर्धयन्तौ ।
बृहस्पते ब्रह्मणा याह्यर्वाङ्यज्ञो अयं स्वरिदं यजमानाय स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina brahmana yatamarvanchau vashatkarena yajnam vardhayantau |
brihaspate brahmana yahyarvanyajno ayam svaridam yajamanaya svaha ||
verses.en: O Açvins, come ye hitherward with worship (bráhman), with váṣaṭ-utterance increasing the sacrifice. O Brihaspati, come hitherward with worship; this sacrifice [is] heaven (svàr) here for the sacrificer: hail!

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वा अस्य समिधो भवन्त्यूर्ध्वा शुक्रा शोचीष्यग्नेः ।
द्युमत्तमा सुप्रतीकः ससूनुस्तनूनपादसुरो भूरिपाणिः ॥
verses.rom:
urdhva asya samidho bhavantyurdhva shukra shochishyagneh |
dyumattama supratikah sasunustanunapadasuro bhuripanih ||

verses.sa: देवो देवेषु देवः पथो अनक्ति मध्वा घृतेन ॥
verses.rom: devo deveshu devah patho anakti madhva ghritena ||

verses.sa: मध्वा यज्ञं नक्षति प्रैणानो नराशंसो अग्निः सुकृद्देवः सविता विश्ववारः ॥
verses.rom: madhva yajnam nakshati prainano narashamso agnih sukriddevah savita vishvavarah ||

verses.sa: अच्छायमेति शवसा घृता चिदीडानो वह्निर्नमसा ॥
verses.rom: achchhayameti shavasa ghrita chididano vahnirnamasa ||

verses.sa: अग्निः स्रुचो अध्वरेषु प्रयक्षु स यक्षदस्य महिमानमग्नेः ॥
verses.rom: agnih srucho adhvareshu prayakshu sa yakshadasya mahimanamagneh ||

verses.sa: तरी मन्द्रासु प्रयक्षु वसवश्चातिष्ठन् वसुधातरश्च ॥
verses.rom: tari mandrasu prayakshu vasavashchatishthan vasudhatarashcha ||

verses.sa: द्वारो देवीरन्वस्य विश्वे व्रतं रक्षन्ति विश्वहा ॥
verses.rom: dvaro deviranvasya vishve vratam rakshanti vishvaha ||

verses.sa:
उरुव्यचसाग्नेर्धाम्ना पत्यमाने ।
आ सुष्वयन्ती यजते उपाके उषासानक्तेमं यज्ञमवतामध्वरं नः ॥
verses.rom:
uruvyachasagnerdhamna patyamane |
a sushvayanti yajate upake ushasanaktemam yajnamavatamadhvaram nah ||

verses.sa:
दैवा होतार ऊर्ध्वमध्वरं नोऽग्नेर्जिह्वयाभि गृनत गृनता नः स्विष्टये ।
तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं सदन्तामिडा सरस्वती मही भारती गृणाना ॥
verses.rom:
daiva hotara urdhvamadhvaram no'gnerjihvayabhi grinata grinata nah svishtaye |
tisro devirbarhiredam sadantamida sarasvati mahi bharati grinana ||

verses.sa:
तन् नस्तुरीपमद्भुतं पुरुक्षु ।
देव त्वष्टा रायस्पोषं वि ष्य नाभिमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
tan nasturipamadbhutam purukshu |
deva tvashta rayasposham vi shya nabhimasya ||

verses.sa:
वनस्पतेऽव सृजा रराणः ।
त्मना देवेभ्यो अग्निर्हव्यं शमिता स्वदयतु ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspate'va srija raranah |
tmana devebhyo agnirhavyam shamita svadayatu ||

verses.sa:
अग्ने स्वाहा कृणुहि जातवेदः ।
इन्द्राय यज्ञं विश्वे देवा हविरिदं जुषन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne svaha krinuhi jatavedah |
indraya yajnam vishve deva haviridam jushantam ||

prose.en:
1. Uplifted becomes his fuel, uplifted the bright burnings of Agni, most brilliant; of beautiful aspect, with his son,—[2.] son of himself (tánūnápāt), ásura, many-handed,—

3. With honey he attains the sacrifice, pleased, the praised of men (nárāçáṅsa), Agni the well-doing, the heavenly impeller (savitár), having all choice things.

4. Here he cometh with might (çávas) unto the various ghees, praising, he the carrier, with homage,—

10. That wonderful seminal fluid (turī́pam) of ours, abounding in food, O god Tvashṭar, abundance of wealth, release thou the navel of it.

11. O forest-tree, let thou loose, bestowing; let Agni [as] queller willingly sweeten the oblation for the gods.

12. O Agni, hail! make thou, O Jātavedas, the sacrifice for Indra; let all the gods enjoy this oblation.

verses.sa:
नव प्राणान् नवभिः सं मिमीते दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय ।
हरिते त्रीणि रजते त्रीण्ययसि त्रीणि तपसाविष्टितानि ॥
verses.rom:
nava pranan navabhih sam mimite dirghayutvaya shatasharadaya |
harite trini rajate trinyayasi trini tapasavishtitani ||
verses.en: Nine breaths with nine he combines (? sam-mā), in order to length of life for a hundred autumns; in the yellow (hárita), three; in silver, three; in iron (? áyas), three—enveloped with fervor.

verses.sa:
अग्निः सूर्यश्चन्द्रमा भूमिरापो द्यौरन्तरिक्षं प्रदिशो दिशश्च ।
आर्तवा ऋतुभिः संविदाना अनेन मा त्रिवृता पारयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
agnih suryashchandrama bhumirapo dyaurantariksham pradisho dishashcha |
artava ritubhih samvidana anena ma trivrita parayantu ||
verses.en: Fire, sun, moon, earth, waters, sky, atmosphere, directions, and quarters, they of the seasons in concord with the seasons—let them rescue (pāray) me by this triple one.

verses.sa:
त्रयः पोषास्त्रिवृति श्रयन्तामनक्तु पूषा पयसा घृतेन ।
अन्नस्य भूमा पुरुषस्य भूमा भूमा पशूनां त इह श्रयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
trayah poshastrivriti shrayantamanaktu pusha payasa ghritena |
annasya bhuma purushasya bhuma bhuma pashunam ta iha shrayantam ||
verses.en: Let three abundances (póṣa) resort to the triple one; let Pūshan anoint it with milk, with ghee; affluence of food, affluence of man (púruṣa), affluence of cattle—let these resort hither.

verses.sa:
इममादित्या वसुना समुक्षतेममग्ने वर्धय ववृधानः ।
इममिन्द्र सं सृज वीर्येणास्मिन् त्रिवृच्छ्रयतां पोषयिष्णु ॥
verses.rom:
imamaditya vasuna samukshatemamagne vardhaya vavridhanah |
imamindra sam srija viryenasmin trivrichchhrayatam poshayishnu ||
verses.en: O Ādityas, sprinkle this man well with good (vásu); O Agni, do thou, thyself increasing, increase him; unite him, O Indra, with heroism; let the prospering triple one resort to him.

verses.sa:
भूमिष्ट्वा पातु हरितेन विश्वभृदग्निः पिपर्त्वयसा सजोषाः ।
वीरुद्भिष्टे अर्जुनं संविदानं दक्षं दधातु सुमनस्यमानम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhumishtva patu haritena vishvabhridagnih pipartvayasa sajoshah |
virudbhishte arjunam samvidanam daksham dadhatu sumanasyamanam ||
verses.en: Let earth, the all-bearing, protect thee with the yellow one; let Agni rescue [thee] in accord with the iron; let the silver one (árjuna), in concord with the plants, bestow (dhā) on thee dexterity, with favoring mind.

verses.sa:
त्रेधा जातं जन्मनेदं हिरण्यमग्नेरेकं प्रियतमं बभूव सोमस्यैकं हिंसितस्य परापतत्।
अपामेकं वेधसां रेत आहुस्तत्ते हिरण्यं त्रिवृदस्त्वायुषे ॥
verses.rom:
tredha jatam janmanedam hiranyamagnerekam priyatamam babhuva somasyaikam himsitasya parapatat|
apamekam vedhasam reta ahustatte hiranyam trivridastvayushe ||
verses.en: Triply born by birth [is] this gold: one was Agni's dearest; one fell away of Soma when injured; one they call the seed of devout waters; let that triple gold be thine in order to life-time.

verses.sa:
त्र्यायुषं जमदग्नेः कश्यपस्य त्र्यायुषम् ।
त्रेधामृतस्य चक्षणं त्रीण्यायूंषि तेऽकरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tryayusham jamadagneh kashyapasya tryayusham |
tredhamritasya chakshanam trinyayumshi te'karam ||
verses.en: Triple life-time of Jamadagni, Kaçyapa's triple life-time, sight of the immortal (amṛ́ta) triply, three life-times have I made for thee.

verses.sa:
त्रयः सुपर्णास्त्रिवृता यदायन्न् एकाक्षरमभिसंभूय शक्राः ।
प्रत्यौहन् मृत्युममृतेन साकमन्तर्दधाना दुरितानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
trayah suparnastrivrita yadayann ekaksharamabhisambhuya shakrah |
pratyauhan mrityumamritena sakamantardadhana duritani vishva ||
verses.en: When the three eagles (suparṇá) went with the triple one, becoming, mighty ones (çakrá), a single syllable, they bore back death along with (sākám) the immortal, warding off (antar-dhā) all difficulties.

verses.sa:
दिवस्त्वा पातु हरितं मध्यात्त्वा पात्वर्जुनम् ।
भूम्या अयस्मयं पातु प्रागाद्देवपुरा अयम् ॥
verses.rom:
divastva patu haritam madhyattva patvarjunam |
bhumya ayasmayam patu pragaddevapura ayam ||
verses.en: From the sky let the yellow one protect thee; from the midst let the silver one protect thee; from the earth let that made of iron protect [thee]; this [man] hath gone forward to strongholds of the gods.

verses.sa:
इमास्तिस्रो देवपुरास्तास्त्वा रक्षन्तु सर्वतः ।
तास्त्वं बिभ्रद्वर्चस्व्युत्तरो द्विषतां भव ॥
verses.rom:
imastisro devapurastastva rakshantu sarvatah |
tastvam bibhradvarchasvyuttaro dvishatam bhava ||
verses.en: These [are] three strongholds of the gods; let them defend thee on all sides; bearing these, do thou, possessing splendor, become superior to them that hate thee.

verses.sa:
पुरं देवानाममृतं हिरण्यं य आबेधे प्रथमो देवो अग्रे ।
तस्मै नमो दश प्राचीः कृणोम्यनु मन्यतां त्रिवृदाबधे मे ॥
verses.rom:
puram devanamamritam hiranyam ya abedhe prathamo devo agre |
tasmai namo dasha prachih krinomyanu manyatam trivridabadhe me ||
verses.en: The stronghold of the gods, deathless (amṛ́ta) gold, what god first bound on in the beginning, to him I pay homage, [my] ten extended [fingers]; let him approve my binding-on the triple one.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा चृतत्वर्यमा पूषा बृहस्पतिः ।
अहर्जातस्य यन् नाम तेन त्वाति चृतामसि ॥
verses.rom:
a tva chritatvaryama pusha brihaspatih |
aharjatasya yan nama tena tvati chritamasi ||
verses.en: Let Aryaman fasten (cṛt) thee on, let Pūshan, let Brihaspati; what is the name of the day-born one, therewith we fasten thee over.

verses.sa:
ऋतुभिष्ट्वार्तवैरायुषे वर्चसे त्वा ।
संवत्सरस्य तेजसा तेन संहनु कृण्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
ritubhishtvartavairayushe varchase tva |
samvatsarasya tejasa tena samhanu krinmasi ||
verses.en: Thee with the seasons, with them of the seasons; thee unto lifetime, unto splendor; with the brilliancy of the year—with that we make [thee] of closed jaw (? sáṁhanu).

verses.sa:
घृतादुल्लुप्तं मधुना समक्तं भूमिदृंहमच्युतं पारयिष्णु ।
भिन्दत्सपत्नान् अधरांश्च कृण्वदा मा रोह महते सौभगाय ॥
verses.rom:
ghritadulluptam madhuna samaktam bhumidrimhamachyutam parayishnu |
bhindatsapatnan adharamshcha krinvada ma roha mahate saubhagaya ||
verses.en: Snatched (lup) out of ghee, anointed over with honey, fixing the earth, unmoved, rescuing, splitting [our] rivals, and putting them down, do thou ascend me in order to great good-fortune.

verses.sa:
पुरस्ताद्युक्तो वह जातवेदोऽग्ने विद्धि क्रियमाणं यथेदम् ।
त्वं भिषग्भेषजस्यासि कर्ता त्वया गामश्वं पुरुषं सनेम ॥
verses.rom:
purastadyukto vaha jatavedo'gne viddhi kriyamanam yathedam |
tvam bhishagbheshajasyasi karta tvaya gamashvam purusham sanema ||
verses.en: Joined in front, carry thou, O Jātavedas; know this, O Agni, as [it is] being done; thou art a physician (bhiṣáj), a maker of remedy (bheṣajá); by thee may we gain cow, horse, man (púruṣa).

verses.sa:
तथा तदग्ने कृणु जातवेदो विश्वेभिर्देवैः सह संविदानः ।
यो नो दिदेव यतमो जघास यथा सो अस्य परिधिष्पताति ॥
verses.rom:
tatha tadagne krinu jatavedo vishvebhirdevaih saha samvidanah |
yo no dideva yatamo jaghasa yatha so asya paridhishpatati ||
verses.en: So, O Agni, Jātavedas, do thou do this, in concord with all the gods: he who hath played [against] us, whosoever hath devoured (ghas) us, that this enclosure of his may fall.

verses.sa:
यथा सो अस्य परिधिष्पताति तथा तदग्ने कृणु जातवेदः ।
विश्वेभिर्देवैर्सह संविदानः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha so asya paridhishpatati tatha tadagne krinu jatavedah |
vishvebhirdevairsaha samvidanah ||
verses.en: That this enclosure of his may fall, so, O Agni, Jātavedas, do thou do that, in concord with all the gods.

verses.sa:
अक्ष्यौ नि विध्य हृदयं नि विध्य जिह्वां नि तृन्द्धि प्र दतो मृणीहि ।
पिशाचो अस्य यतमो जघासाग्ने यविष्ठ प्रति तं शृणीहि ॥
verses.rom:
akshyau ni vidhya hridayam ni vidhya jihvam ni trinddhi pra dato mrinihi |
pishacho asya yatamo jaghasagne yavishtha prati tam shrinihi ||
verses.en: Pierce thou into his eyes, pierce into his heart, bore into his tongue, destroy (pra-mṛ) his teeth; whatsoever piçācá hath devoured of him, that one, O Agni, youngest [god], do thou crush back.

verses.sa:
यदस्य हृतं विहृतं यत्पराभृतमात्मनो जग्धं यतमत्पिशाचैः ।
तदग्ने विद्वान् पुनरा भर त्वं शरीरे मांसमसुमेरयामः ॥
verses.rom:
yadasya hritam vihritam yatparabhritamatmano jagdham yatamatpishachaih |
tadagne vidvan punara bhara tvam sharire mamsamasumerayamah ||
verses.en: What of him is taken [or] taken apart, what is borne away, whatsoever of himself is devoured by the piçācás, that, O Agni, do thou, knowing, bring again; into his body we send flesh [and] spirit (ásu).

verses.sa:
आमे सुपक्वे शबले विपक्वे यो मा पिशाचो अशने ददम्भ ।
तदात्मना प्रजया पिशाचा वि यातयन्तामगदोऽयमस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
ame supakve shabale vipakve yo ma pishacho ashane dadambha |
tadatmana prajaya pishacha vi yatayantamagado'yamastu ||
verses.en: In raw, in well-cooked, in mixed (? çabála), in ripe, what piçācá hath injured (dambh) me in the partaking—that let the piçācás atone for (? vi-yātay) with self [and] progeny; be this man free from disease.

verses.sa:
क्षीरे मा मन्थे यतमो ददम्भाकृष्टपच्ये अशने धान्ये यः ।
तदात्मना प्रजया पिशाचा वि यातयन्तामगदोऽयमस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
kshire ma manthe yatamo dadambhakrishtapachye ashane dhanye yah |
tadatmana prajaya pishacha vi yatayantamagado'yamastu ||
verses.en: In milk (kṣīrá), in stirabout whoever hath injured me, who in grain growing uncultivated—in the partaking [thereof]—that let the piçācás etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अपां मा पाने यतमो ददम्भ क्रव्याद्यातूनां शयने शयानम् ।
तदात्मना प्रजया पिशाचा वि यातयन्तामगदोऽयमस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
apam ma pane yatamo dadambha kravyadyatunam shayane shayanam |
tadatmana prajaya pishacha vi yatayantamagado'yamastu ||
verses.en: In the drinking of waters whatever flesh-eater hath injured me lying (çī) in the lair (çáyana) of the familiar demons (yātú)—that let the piçācás etc. etc.

verses.sa:
दिवा मा नक्तं यतमो ददम्भ क्रव्याद्यातूनां शयने शयानम् ।
तदात्मना प्रजया पिशाचा वि यातयन्तामगदोऽयमस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
diva ma naktam yatamo dadambha kravyadyatunam shayane shayanam |
tadatmana prajaya pishacha vi yatayantamagado'yamastu ||
verses.en: By day, by night, whatever flesh-eater hath injured me lying in the lair of the familiar demons—that let the piçācás etc. etc.

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादमग्ने रुधिरं पिशाचं मनोहनं जहि जातवेदः ।
तमिन्द्रो वाजी वज्रेण हन्तु छिनत्तु सोमः शिरो अस्य धृष्णुः ॥
verses.rom:
kravyadamagne rudhiram pishacham manohanam jahi jatavedah |
tamindro vaji vajrena hantu chhinattu somah shiro asya dhrishnuh ||
verses.en: The flesh-eating, bloody (rudhirá), mind-slaying piçācá do thou slay, O Agni, Jātavedas; let the vigorous Indra slay him with the thunderbolt; let bold Soma cut [off] his head.

verses.sa:
सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान् न त्वा रक्षांसि पृतनासु जिग्युः ।
सहमूरान् अनु दह क्रव्यादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः ॥
verses.rom:
sanadagne mrinasi yatudhanan na tva rakshamsi pritanasu jigyuh |
sahamuran anu daha kravyado ma te hetya mukshata daivyayah ||
verses.en: From of old, O Agni, thou killest the sorcerers; the demons have not conquered thee in fights; burn up the flesh-eaters together with their dupes (?); let them not be freed from thy heavenly missile.

verses.sa:
समाहर जातवेदो यद्धृतं यत्पराभृतम् ।
गात्राण्यस्य वर्धन्तामंशुरिवा प्यायतामयम् ॥
verses.rom:
samahara jatavedo yaddhritam yatparabhritam |
gatranyasya vardhantamamshuriva pyayatamayam ||
verses.en: Bring together, O Jātavedas, what is taken, what borne away; let his members (gā́tra) increase; let this man fill up like a soma-stalk.

verses.sa:
सोमस्येव जातवेदो अंशुरा प्यायतामयम् ।
अग्ने विरप्शिनं मेध्यमयक्ष्मं कृणु जीवतु ॥
verses.rom:
somasyeva jatavedo amshura pyayatamayam |
agne virapshinam medhyamayakshmam krinu jivatu ||
verses.en: Like a stalk of soma, O Jātavedas, let this man fill up; make him, O Agni, exuberant, sacrificial (médhya), free from yákṣma; let him live.

verses.sa:
एतास्ते अग्ने समिधः पिशाचजम्भनीः ।
तास्त्वं जुषस्व प्रति चैना गृहाण जातवेदः ॥
verses.rom:
etaste agne samidhah pishachajambhanih |
tastvam jushasva prati chaina grihana jatavedah ||
verses.en: These, O Agni, are thy piçācá-grinding pieces of fuel; them do thou enjoy, and accept them, O Jātavedas.

verses.sa:
तार्ष्टाघीरग्ने समिधः प्रति गृह्णाह्यर्चिषा ।
जहातु क्रव्याद्रूपं यो अस्य मांसं जिहीर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
tarshtaghiragne samidhah prati grihnahyarchisha |
jahatu kravyadrupam yo asya mamsam jihirshati ||
verses.en: The pieces of fuel of tārṣṭāghá, O Agni, do thou accept with flame (arcís); let the flesh-eater who wants to take this man's flesh (māṅsá) quit his form.

verses.sa:
आवतस्त आवतः परावतस्त आवतः ।
इहैव भव मा नु गा मा पूर्वान् अनु गाः पितॄन् असुं बध्नामि ते दृढम् ॥
verses.rom:
avatasta avatah paravatasta avatah |
ihaiva bhava ma nu ga ma purvan anu gah pitrin asum badhnami te dridham ||
verses.en: Thy nearnesses [are] nearnesses, thy distances nearnesses; be just here; go not now; go not after the former Fathers; thy life (ásu) I bind fast.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वाभिचेरुः पुरुषः स्वो यदरणो जनः ।
उन्मोचनप्रमोचने उभे वाचा वदामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
yattvabhicheruh purushah svo yadarano janah |
unmochanapramochane ubhe vacha vadami te ||
verses.en: In that men have bewitched thee, one of thine own people [or] a strange person—deliverance and release, both I speak for thee with my voice.

verses.sa:
यद्दुद्रोहिथ शेपिषे स्त्रियै पुंसे अचित्त्या ।
उन्मोचनप्रमोचने उभे वाचा वदामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
yaddudrohitha shepishe striyai pumse achittya |
unmochanapramochane ubhe vacha vadami te ||
verses.en: In that thou hast shown malice (druh), hast cursed at woman [or] at man through thoughtlessness, deliverance and etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यतेनसो मातृकृताच्छेषे पितृकृताच्च यत्।
उन्मोचनप्रमोचने उभे वाचा वदामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
yatenaso matrikritachchheshe pitrikritachcha yat|
unmochanapramochane ubhe vacha vadami te ||
verses.en: In that thou art prostrate (çī) from sin that is mother-committed and that is father-committed, deliverance and etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यत्ते माता यत्ते पिता जमिर्भ्राता च सर्जतः ।
प्रत्यक्सेवस्व भेषजं जरदष्टिं कृणोमि त्वा ॥
verses.rom:
yatte mata yatte pita jamirbhrata cha sarjatah |
pratyaksevasva bheshajam jaradashtim krinomi tva ||
verses.en: What thy mother, what thy father, sister (jāmí), and brother shall infuse (? sárjatas)—heed (sev) thou the opposing remedy; I make thee one who reaches old age.

verses.sa:
इहैधि पुरुष सर्वेण मनसा सह ।
दूतौ यमस्य मानु गा अधि जीवपुरा इहि ॥
verses.rom:
ihaidhi purusha sarvena manasa saha |
dutau yamasya manu ga adhi jivapura ihi ||
verses.en: Be thou here, O man, together with thy whole mind; go not after Yama's (two) messengers; go unto the strongholds of the living.

verses.sa:
अनुहूतः पुनरेहि विद्वान् उदयनं पथः ।
आरोहणमाक्रमणं जीवतोजीवतोऽयनम् ॥
verses.rom:
anuhutah punarehi vidvan udayanam pathah |
arohanamakramanam jivatojivato'yanam ||
verses.en: Being called after, come thou again, knowing the up-going of the road, the ascent, the climb (ākrámaṇa), the course (áyana) of every living man.

verses.sa:
मा बिभेर्न मरिष्यसि जरदष्टिं कृणोमि त्वा ।
निरवोचमहं यक्ष्ममङ्गेभ्यो अङ्गज्वरं तव ॥
verses.rom:
ma bibherna marishyasi jaradashtim krinomi tva |
niravochamaham yakshmamangebhyo angajvaram tava ||
verses.en: Be not afraid; thou shalt not die; I make thee one who reaches old age; I have exorcised (nir-vac) the yákṣma, the waster of limbs, from thy limbs.

verses.sa:
अङ्गभेदो अङ्गज्वरो यश्च ते हृदयामयः ।
यक्ष्मः श्येन इव प्रापप्तद्वचा साढः परस्तराम् ॥
verses.rom:
angabhedo angajvaro yashcha te hridayamayah |
yakshmah shyena iva prapaptadvacha sadhah parastaram ||
verses.en: The splitter of limbs, the waster of limbs, and the heart-ache that is thine, the yákṣma hath flown forth like a falcon, forced (sah) very far away by [my] voice.

verses.sa:
ऋषी बोधप्रतीबोधावस्वप्नो यश्च जागृविः ।
तौ ते प्राणस्य गोप्तारौ दिवा नक्तं च जागृताम् ॥
verses.rom:
rishi bodhapratibodhavasvapno yashcha jagrivih |
tau te pranasya goptarau diva naktam cha jagritam ||
verses.en: The two seers, Wakeful-and- Vigilant, sleepless and he that is watchful—let them, the guardians of thy breath, watch by day and by night.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निरुपसद्य इह सूर्य उदेतु ते ।
उदेहि मृत्योर्गम्भीरात्कृष्णाच्चित्तमसस्परि ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagnirupasadya iha surya udetu te |
udehi mrityorgambhiratkrishnachchittamasaspari ||
verses.en: This Agni [is] to be waited on; here let the sun arise for thee; come up out of death's profound black darkness.

verses.sa:
नमो यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे नमः पितृभ्य उत ये नयन्ति ।
उत्पारणस्य यो वेद तमग्निं पुरो दधेऽस्मा अरिष्टतातये ॥
verses.rom:
namo yamaya namo astu mrityave namah pitribhya uta ye nayanti |
utparanasya yo veda tamagnim puro dadhe'sma arishtatataye ||
verses.en: Homage to Yama, homage be to Death; homage to the Fathers, and [to them] who conduct [away]; that Agni who understands (vid)

verses.sa:
ऐतु प्राण ऐतु मन ऐतु चक्षुरथो बलम् ।
शरीरमस्य सं विदां तत्पद्भ्यां प्रति तिष्ठतु ॥
verses.rom:
aitu prana aitu mana aitu chakshuratho balam |
shariramasya sam vidam tatpadbhyam prati tishthatu ||
verses.en: Let breath come, let mind come, let sight come, then strength; let his body assemble (? sam-vid); let that stand firm with its (two) feet.

verses.sa:
प्राणेनाग्ने चक्षुषा सं सृजेमं समीरय तन्वा सं बलेन ।
वेत्थामृतस्य मा नु गान् मा नु भूमिगृहो भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
pranenagne chakshusha sam srijemam samiraya tanva sam balena |
vetthamritasya ma nu gan ma nu bhumigriho bhuvat ||
verses.en: With breath, O Agni, with sight unite him; associate (sam-īray) him with body, with strength; thou understandest immortality (amṛ́ta): let him not now go; let him not now become one housing in the earth.

verses.sa:
मा ते प्राण उप दसन् मो अपानोऽपि धायि ते ।
सूर्यस्त्वाधिपतिर्मृत्योरुदायच्छतु रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ma te prana upa dasan mo apano'pi dhayi te |
suryastvadhipatirmrityorudayachchhatu rashmibhih ||
verses.en: Let not thy breath give out, nor let thine expiration be shut up; let the sun, the over-lord, hold thee up out of death by his rays.

verses.sa:
इयमन्तर्वदति जिह्वा बद्धा पनिष्पदा ।
त्वया यक्ष्मं निरवोचं शतं रोपीश्च तक्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
iyamantarvadati jihva baddha panishpada |
tvaya yakshmam niravocham shatam ropishcha takmanah ||
verses.en: This much-quivering tongue, bound, speaks within; by it I have exorcised the yákṣma and the hundred pangs of the fever.

verses.sa:
अयं लोकः प्रियतमो देवानामपराजितः ।
यस्मै त्वमिह मृत्यवे दिष्टः पुरुष जज्ञिषे ।
स च त्वानु ह्वयामसि मा पुरा जरसो मृथाः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam lokah priyatamo devanamaparajitah |
yasmai tvamiha mrityave dishtah purusha jajnishe |
sa cha tvanu hvayamasi ma pura jaraso mrithah ||
verses.en: This [is] the dearest world of the gods, unconquered. Unto what death appointed, O man, thou wast born here, we and it call after thee: do not die before old age.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुरामे पात्रे यां चक्रुर्मिश्रधान्ये ।
आमे मांसे कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam te chakrurame patre yam chakrurmishradhanye |
ame mamse krityam yam chakruh punah prati harami tam ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft] they have made for thee in a raw vessel, what they have made in one of mixed grains; in raw flesh what witchcraft they have made—I take that back again.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुः कृकवाकावजे वा यां कुरीरिणि ।
अव्यां ते कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam te chakruh krikavakavaje va yam kuririni |
avyam te krityam yam chakruh punah prati harami tam ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft] they have made for thee in a cock, or what in a kurī́ra-wearing goat; in a ewe what witchcraft they have made—I take that back again.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुरेकशफे पशूनामुभयादति ।
गर्दभे कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam te chakrurekashaphe pashunamubhayadati |
gardabhe krityam yam chakruh punah prati harami tam ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft] they have made for thee in the one-hoofed, in the one with teeth in both jaws, among cattle; in a donkey what witchcraft they have made—I take that back again.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुरमूलायां वलगं वा नराच्याम् ।
क्षेत्रे ते कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam te chakruramulayam valagam va narachyam |
kshetre te krityam yam chakruh punah prati harami tam ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft] they have made for thee in a rootless [plant], or [what] secret spell (? valagá) in a narācī́; in thy field what witchcraft they have made—I take that back again.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुर्गार्हपत्ये पूर्वाग्नावुत दुश्चितः ।
शालायां कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam te chakrurgarhapatye purvagnavuta dushchitah |
shalayam krityam yam chakruh punah prati harami tam ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft] they have made for thee in the householder's fire, also, malevolent (duçcít), in the eastern fire; in the dwelling what witchcraft they have made—I take that back again.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुः सभायां यां चक्रुरधिदेवने ।
अक्षेषु कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam te chakruh sabhayam yam chakruradhidevane |
aksheshu krityam yam chakruh punah prati harami tam ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft] they have made for thee in the assembly (sabhá), what they have made at the gambling-board; in the dice what witchcraft they have made—I take that back again.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुः सेनायां यां चक्रुरिष्वायुधे ।
दुन्दुभौ कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam te chakruh senayam yam chakrurishvayudhe |
dundubhau krityam yam chakruh punah prati harami tam ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft] they have made for thee in the army (sénā), what they have made in arrow-and-weapon; in the drum what witchcraft they have made—I take that back again.

verses.sa:
यां ते कृत्यां कूपेऽवदधुः श्मशाने वा निचख्नुः ।
सद्मनि कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam te krityam kupe'vadadhuh shmashane va nichakhnuh |
sadmani krityam yam chakruh punah prati harami tam ||
verses.en: What witchcraft they have put down for thee in the well, or have dug in at the cemetery; in the seat (sádman) what witchcraft they have made—I take that back again.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुः पुरुषास्थे अग्नौ संकसुके च याम् ।
म्रोकं निर्दाहं क्रव्यादं पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam te chakruh purushasthe agnau samkasuke cha yam |
mrokam nirdaham kravyadam punah prati harami tam ||
verses.en: What [witchcraft] they have made for thee in the human-bone, and what in the destroying (? sáṁkasuka) fire, [what] dimming, out-burning, flesh-eating one—I take that back again.

verses.sa:
अपथेना जभारैनां तां पथेतः प्र हिण्मसि ।
अधीरो मर्याधीरेभ्यः सं जभाराचित्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
apathena jabharainam tam pathetah pra hinmasi |
adhiro maryadhirebhyah sam jabharachittya ||
verses.en: He hath brought it by what was not the road; we send it forth from here by the road; he unwise, O men, hath brought [it] together, out of thoughtlessness, for the wise (dhī́ra).

verses.sa:
यश्चकार न शशाक कर्तुं शश्रे पादमङ्गुरिम् ।
चकार भद्रमस्मभ्यमभगो भगवद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yashchakara na shashaka kartum shashre padamangurim |
chakara bhadramasmabhyamabhago bhagavadbhyah ||
verses.en: He who hath made hath not been able to make; he hath crushed a foot, a finger; he, fortuneless, hath made what is excellent for us [who are] fortunate ones.

verses.sa:
कृत्याकृतं वलगिनं मूलिनं शपथेय्यम् ।
इन्द्रस्तं हन्तु महता वधेनाग्निर्विध्यत्वस्तया ॥
verses.rom:
krityakritam valaginam mulinam shapatheyyam |
indrastam hantu mahata vadhenagnirvidhyatvastaya ||
verses.en: The witchcraft-maker, spell-hider, root-possessor, worthy of cursing—let Indra smite him with his great deadly weapon; let Agni pierce him with a hurled [arrow].
